title_zh: EU ETS：2025合规表已发布，生铁／钢生产记录完成限定范围核验
title_en: EU ETS: 2025 compliance workbook published; scoped iron/steel check completed
summary_zh: 官方登记册于10月5日列出2025合规表。本轮读取XLSX的Export Worksheet及activity codes工作表，筛选COMPLIANCE_STATUS_LATEST_YEAR=2025、MAIN_ACTIVITY_TYPE_CODE为5或24（生铁或钢生产），得到180条记录：合规代码A为175条、B为4条、C为1条。计数仅覆盖上述活动与年份筛选，不代表整个钢铁价值链；TOTAL_VERIFIED_EMISSIONS与TOTAL_SURRENDERED_ALLOWANCES字段不在本条中作为2025年度总量使用。代码含义与具体异常原因仍需结合EUTL说明和主管机关记录核实。
summary_en: The Registry listed the 2025 workbook on 5 October. Reading both worksheets and filtering latest compliance year=2025 and main activity code 5 or 24 (pig iron or steel) yields 180 records: code A 175, B 4, C 1. This is a scoped record count, not a whole steel value-chain total. Total emissions/surrender fields are not treated as annual 2025 totals. Code meanings and case-specific causes require EUTL guidance and authority records.
impact_zh: 这份表可支持核对欧盟钢铁装置的合规记录；不能据代码分布推导中国钢材CBAM税额、装置年度排放强度或行业违法比例。对合作装置逐一核对登记册标识、年份和官方解释，再判断是否需要补充尽调。
impact_en: Use the workbook to check EU installation records. Code counts do not establish Chinese steel CBAM charges, annual emissions intensity or an industry breach rate. Verify installation IDs, years and official interpretations before further due diligence.
follow_up: 已完成发布入口和代码5/24、最新合规年份2025的限定计数核验；后续如需年度排放或装置风险结论，另查年度核验排放表、EUTL代码解释及主管机关记录。
coverage: 2026-10-09已读9月25日通知、登记册报告列表和10月5日官方XLSX两工作表；核对字段、活动代码及上述180条记录的代码分布，未核验各装置异常原因，未计算行业年度排放或清缴总量。

title_zh: 英国 CBAM 准备事项更新：纳入排放与核查法规
title_en: UK CBAM preparation hub adds emissions and verification legislation
summary_zh: HMRC 于 9 月 9 日更新 CBAM 汇总页，加入排放与核查法规及利息生效令的入口。页面明确制度自 2027 年 1 月 1 日起适用，注册于 2028 年 1 月 1 日开放。
summary_en: HMRC updated the preparation hub on 9 September with emissions and verification legislation and the interest appointed-day order. CBAM applies from 1 January 2027; registration opens on 1 January 2028.
impact_zh: 跟踪判断：对英钢材订单应提前安排排放数据和进口记录；注册开放时间不能当作制度起征时间。
impact_en: Monitoring assessment: plan emissions data and import records for UK steel orders. Registration opening and the start of the regime are different dates.

title_zh: 英国 CBAM 税收影响说明更新：调整企业成本估计
title_en: UK CBAM tax impact note revises estimates of business costs
summary_zh: HMRC 于 9 月 9 日更新税收信息与影响说明，调整企业一次性成本及持续行政负担估计。页面确认 CBAM 从 2027 年 1 月 1 日适用于钢铁等五类行业商品。
summary_en: HMRC updated the tax impact note on 9 September, revising estimates of one-off business costs and ongoing administrative burdens. It confirms application from 1 January 2027 to goods in five sectors including iron and steel.
impact_zh: 跟踪判断：这次更新涉及成本估计，不能据此直接推导某一钢材订单的具体税额。
impact_en: Monitoring assessment: this update concerns cost estimates and does not establish the tax payable on a specific steel order.

title_zh: 欧盟对取向电工钢实施临时保障措施，涉及配额与价格门槛
title_en: EU imposes provisional GOES safeguards with quotas and price thresholds
summary_zh: 欧委会于 9 月 18 日宣布对进口取向电工钢采取临时保障措施，形式为关税配额结合价格门槛。范围包括加工后的叠片和铁芯，以及已装入变压器的铁芯。
summary_en: On 18 September the Commission announced provisional safeguards on grain-oriented electrical steel, using tariff-rate quotas and price thresholds. The scope includes laminations, cores and cores incorporated in transformers.
impact_zh: 跟踪判断：出口取向电工钢及相关下游产品需核对正式法规中的产品范围、配额与价格条件；该公告不是最终保障措施。
impact_en: Monitoring assessment: exporters should check the legal product scope, quotas and price conditions. These are provisional measures.

coverage: Official news-list summary; full article not accessible during review.
title_zh: 欧委会发布 CBAM 核查机构资源汇总，涵盖注册与培训
title_en: Commission publishes a resource overview for CBAM verifiers
summary_zh: DG TAXUD 于 9 月 28 日的官方新闻列表说明，新资源汇总包含核查与认可指南、CBAM 注册系统访问说明、已获认可核查机构的操作文件，以及 O3CI 门户培训视频。
summary_en: The official DG TAXUD news listing dated 28 September describes a resource overview covering verification and accreditation guidance, registry access, operational documents for accredited verifiers and O3CI training videos.
impact_zh: 跟踪判断：可作为钢厂与核查服务商确认系统访问、资料准备及配合流程的资料入口。以上依据官方新闻列表摘要，详细要求需查阅所链接文件。
impact_en: Monitoring assessment: use the resources to coordinate registry access, documentation and workflows with verifiers. This brief is based on the official listing; consult the linked documents for full requirements.

title_zh: CBAM 证书操作说明：2026 年排放于 2027 年购证清缴
title_en: CBAM certificate factsheet: 2026 emissions settled in 2027
summary_zh: 9 月 30 日发布的说明：证书拟于 2027 年 2 月 1 日开售；2026 年无季度持证义务，相关证书须于 2027 年 9 月 30 日前购买并清缴。此后季度末持证覆盖至少 50% 的年内累计隐含排放；最终数量按适用规则调整。
summary_en: The 30 September factsheet schedules sales for 1 February 2027. No quarterly holding obligation applies in 2026; certificates for that year's emissions must be purchased and surrendered by 30 September 2027. Subsequent quarter-end holdings cover at least 50% of year-to-date embedded emissions, subject to applicable adjustments.
impact_zh: 跟踪判断：与进口商分别安排 2026 年排放资料和 2027 年资金；购证延后不代表 2026 年进口免除碳成本。
impact_en: Assessment: separate 2026 emissions documentation from 2027 funding. Deferred certificate purchases do not exempt 2026 imports from carbon costs.
coverage: Official two-page factsheet reviewed; explanatory guidance, not a new regulation.

title_zh: 欧委会更新 CBAM 证书说明与传播资料
title_en: Commission updates CBAM certificate communication resources
summary_zh: 官方资料页于 9 月 30 日列出《How CBAM certificates work》说明，介绍年度申报、清缴及证书管理。
summary_en: The official resource page lists the 30 September certificate factsheet, covering annual declarations, surrender and certificate management.
impact_zh: 跟踪判断：将说明提供给进口客户，并结合正式法规核对履约安排。
impact_en: Assessment: share the factsheet with importing customers and check implementation against legislation.

title_zh: CBAM 核查机构培训入口更新：通过 O3CI 连接工厂与核查数据
title_en: CBAM verifier training resources: connect installations through O3CI
summary_zh: 9 月 28 日新闻入口指向注册系统页。页面说明，已获认可核查机构通过 O3CI 申请登记，连接非欧盟装置、审阅排放数据与证明材料并出具核查报告；工厂与核查机构虽使用同一门户，职责不同。
summary_en: The 28 September resource link points to the Registry page. Accredited verifiers use O3CI to request registration, connect to non-EU installations, review emissions and supporting evidence, and issue verification reports. Operators and verifiers share a portal but perform different roles.
impact_zh: 跟踪判断：协调工厂和核查服务商的账户、访问权限及资料交付，系统登记不等同于取得认可资质。
impact_en: Assessment: coordinate accounts, access and evidence delivery; Registry registration is distinct from accreditation.
coverage: Official Registry page reviewed; individual training videos not watched.

title_zh: 美国镀锡板等调查进入最终阶段：12 月 4 日举行产业损害听证
title_en: US tin mill investigations: final-phase injury hearing on 4 December
summary_zh: USITC 公告安排中国、台湾和土耳其镀锡板等产品调查最终阶段，案号 701-TA-792、731-TA-1786-1788；范围包括镀锡及镀铬/氧化铬薄板。听证 12 月 4 日，听证申请 11 月 25 日前、庭前陈述 11 月 27 日前、庭后书面意见 12 月 11 日前；书面产品描述优先于 HTSUS 编码。
summary_en: USITC schedules the final phase in cases 701-TA-792 and 731-TA-1786-1788 concerning tin- and chromium-coated tin mill products. Hearing: 4 December; hearing requests: 25 November; prehearing briefs: 27 November; posthearing submissions: 11 December. Written scope controls over tariff codes.
impact_zh: 跟踪判断：对美镀锡板及 TFS 业务应交由应诉团队核对产品范围、参加调查和提交期限；本公告是程序安排，没有公布最终税率。
impact_en: Assessment: coordinate scope and participation deadlines with counsel for US tinplate/TFS business. This is a procedural schedule, not a final duty rate.

follow_up.action_zh: 应诉团队核对参加调查登记及 APO 申请期限：公告要求不晚于听证前 21 天；后续听证申请截止 11 月 25 日
follow_up.action_en: Counsel to check appearance/APO deadlines (at least 21 days before hearing); hearing request deadline is 25 November.

title_zh: 美国对华预包装无螺栓钢货架复审：撤税可能导致损害延续或再现
title_en: US Chinese boltless shelving review: injury likely to continue or recur if duties revoked
summary_zh: USITC 于 9 月 29 日公布第二次日落复审裁定，案号 701-TA-523、731-TA-1259：撤销对华预包装无螺栓钢货架反倾销、反补贴令，可能导致美国行业实质损害延续或再现。裁定于 9 月 24 日完成。
summary_en: The 29 September notice publishes USITC's second sunset-review determination in cases 701-TA-523 and 731-TA-1259: revoking the Chinese boltless shelving AD/CVD orders would likely lead to continuing or recurring material injury. The determination was completed on 24 September.
impact_zh: 跟踪判断：不能按即将撤税报价；具体税率与商务部续令须另查。本裁定针对预包装货架，不等同于对所有钢材新增双反税。
impact_en: Assessment: do not price on an assumed duty removal; check Commerce's continuation notice and applicable rates. The determination concerns prepackaged shelving.

title_zh: 欧盟启动中国与台湾冷轧不锈钢板卷反倾销到期复审
title_en: EU opens expiry review of Chinese and Taiwanese cold-rolled stainless steel
summary_zh: 欧盟公报 C/2026/4830 启动冷轧不锈钢板卷到期复审，涉及 CN 7219、7220 下列明子目。复审调查期为 2025 年 7 月 1 日至 2026 年 6 月 30 日；针对立案的意见原则上须在 9 月 15 日公布后 37 天内提交。
summary_en: Notice C/2026/4830 opens an expiry review of cold-rolled stainless flat products under listed CN 7219/7220 subheadings. Review period: 1 July 2025–30 June 2026. Comments on initiation are generally due within 37 days of publication on 15 September.
impact_zh: 跟踪判断：这不是撤税或新税率公告。涉及不锈钢出口的企业应让应诉团队确认适用范围、抽样与已过/尚未到期的不同提交期限。
impact_en: Assessment: this is not a duty-removal or new-rate notice. Counsel should distinguish scope, sampling and separate submission deadlines.

follow_up.action_zh: 核对立案意见 37 天期限及应诉文件实际到期日
follow_up.action_en: Check the 37-day initiation-comment deadline and case-specific filing dates.

title_zh: 欧盟对华硅锰焊丝临时反倾销：税率 75.3%—102.4%
title_en: EU provisional AD on Chinese silico-manganese welding wire: 75.3%–102.4%
summary_zh: 条例 (EU) 2026/1929 于 8 月 10 日公布、次日生效，针对符合成分及直径条件的硅锰钢丝，TARIC 7229200010。常州运河 75.3%，Juli 集团 102.4%，其他合作企业 93.1%，其他中国进口 102.4%；个别税率需符合规定的商业发票。
summary_en: Regulation (EU) 2026/1929, published 10 August and effective the next day, imposes provisional duties on specified silico-manganese wire (TARIC 7229200010): Yunhe 75.3%, Juli 102.4%, other cooperating firms 93.1%, all other Chinese imports 102.4%. Individual rates require a compliant invoice.
impact_zh: 跟踪判断：仅对该产品条件适用，不能外推到普通线材；放行需相当于临时税额的担保，后续终裁可能调整。
impact_en: Assessment: apply only to the defined wire, not all wire rod. Release requires security equivalent to the provisional duty; definitive findings may change.

title_zh: 首钢与力拓投运高炉煤气碳捕集试验：设计年捕集量 1 万吨
title_en: Shougang and Rio Tinto commission blast-furnace carbon capture trial
summary_zh: 力拓 9 月 28 日公司公告确认首钢京唐高炉煤气碳捕集试验设施投运：设计处理量最高 3,000 立方米/小时，年捕集量最高 10,000 吨 CO₂。项目属于双方 2022 年合作备忘录下的技术研发。
summary_en: Rio Tinto's 28 September release confirms commissioning of a blast-furnace gas trial at Shougang Jingtang, designed for up to 3,000 m³/hour and 10,000 tonnes of CO₂/year, under the partners' 2022 memorandum.
impact_zh: 跟踪判断：可向客户说明低碳技术进展，但设计捕集量不是已实现减排量，也不能直接换算成某钢卷已核验的 CBAM 排放值。
impact_en: Assessment: useful technology evidence for customers; design capture capacity is not achieved abatement or a verified coil-specific CBAM value.
coverage: Corporate primary-source release checked; no independent performance verification.

title_zh: 欧盟钢铁新规运行情况咨询已关闭，进入后续评估跟踪阶段
title_en: EU steel regulation monitoring consultation has closed; follow-up assessment now pending
summary_zh: 欧委会页面现已标为“Closed”，并确认回复期于2026年10月11日23:59（CEST）结束。该定向咨询围绕条例（EU）2026/1384实施首个季度的实际影响，面向上游钢企、下游用户、协会、第三国政府和出口商；不同产品类别原可分别提交回复。页面尚未公布反馈汇总、评估结论或配额、税率调整。
summary_en: The Commission page is now marked Closed and confirms that responses ended on 11 October 2026 at 23:59 CEST. The targeted consultation covered first-quarter implementation impacts of Regulation (EU) 2026/1384 and invited producers, users, associations, third-country governments and exporters, with separate product-category responses allowed. No response summary, assessment conclusion, quota change or rate change has yet been published.
impact_zh: 提交窗口已经结束。已参与企业应保存问卷、附件和提交回执，后续核对欧委会评估及任何正式修法；未参与企业不能再把该页面当作仍可提交的入口，可整理配额、交付与成本证据供后续监测或下一轮咨询使用。咨询关闭本身不改变现行配额或税率。
impact_en: The submission window has ended. Participants should retain responses, attachments and receipts and monitor the Commission's assessment and any formal amendment. Non-participants should not treat the page as an open submission route; preserve quota, delivery and cost evidence for later monitoring or consultations. Closure itself changes no quota or duty rate.

follow_up.action_zh: 保存已提交材料与回执，跟踪欧委会反馈汇总、运行评估及任何正式调整
follow_up.action_en: Retain submissions and receipts; monitor the Commission's response summary, assessment and any formal change.

coverage: 2026-10-12已读欧委会咨询页面当前全文，核对Closed状态、原开放日期、截止时间、目标受众及回复期结束提示；页面尚无反馈汇总、评估结果或规则调整。

title_zh: 欧盟钢铁新规首次产品范围咨询已于 9 月 30 日关闭
title_en: EU steel first product-scope consultation closed on 30 September
summary_zh: 7 月 30 日启动的首次产品范围咨询已于 9 月 30 日 23:59（CEST）结束。页面涉及铸铁管、合金钢丝、不锈钢丝及锻制条钢的范围评估；欧委会须在 12 月 31 日前评估是否需要修改产品范围。
summary_en: The consultation opened on 30 July closed on 30 September at 23:59 CEST. It concerns scope assessment for cast-iron tubes, alloy wire, stainless wire and forged bars; assessment is required by 31 December.
impact_zh: 跟踪判断：不要与 10 月 11 日截止的运行情况咨询混淆；范围评估不等于这些产品已经全部纳入新措施。
impact_en: Assessment: distinguish this closed exercise from the monitoring consultation closing 11 October. Assessment is not automatic inclusion.

title_zh: GFSEC 通过密尔沃基框架：加强贸易救济、反规避与熔炼浇铸地透明度
title_en: GFSEC Milwaukee Framework: trade remedies, anti-circumvention and melt-and-pour transparency
summary_zh: USTR 9 月 30 日确认 GFSEC 部长会议通过联合行动框架。正式文件提出在各自法律框架下减少扭曲市场的支持、强化熔炼浇铸地数据、开展反倾销/反补贴/保障措施调查并协调反规避；各成员实施力度可因国内情况不同。
summary_en: USTR confirmed agreement on 30 September. The framework calls for reducing distortive support, improving melt-and-pour data, trade-remedy investigations and coordinated anti-circumvention, within national legal frameworks; implementation may differ by member.
impact_zh: 跟踪判断：中国钢材及含钢下游产品的多市场贸易救济与溯源风险上升。准备真实熔炼浇铸地、生产商及加工链证明，关注各国后续公告；框架本身没有设定统一新增税率，也不是 G20 全体已一致加税。
impact_en: Assessment: monitor trade-remedy and traceability risks across markets. Prepare melt-and-pour and processing-chain evidence and check subsequent national measures. The framework itself sets no uniform new tariff and is not a unanimous G20 tariff decision.
coverage: USTR release and final GFSEC framework/ministerial statement checked.

title_zh: 英国钢铁措施缩小范围：两项非合金钢丝编码税率降为 0%
title_en: UK steel measure removes two non-alloy wire codes from 1 October
summary_zh: 英国政府10月1日更新钢铁贸易措施，将非合金钢丝商品编码72173049和72173090移出适用范围，对应税率由50%降为0%；Category 28配额量保持不变。其他纳入范围的产品配额外税率仍为50%。
summary_en: The UK updated its steel trade measure on 1 October, removing non-alloy wire codes 72173049 and 72173090. Their tariff falls from 50% to 0%; Category 28 quota volumes are unchanged. The 50% out-of-quota tariff remains for other covered products.
impact_zh: 跟踪判断：涉及上述两个编码的在途和新订单应立即复核英国报关税率及商品归类；该变化不适用于Category 28其他钢丝编码，也没有增加剩余配额。
impact_en: Assessment: recheck UK classification and entry treatment for shipments under these two codes. The change does not cover other Category 28 wire codes or increase the remaining quota.
coverage: Official GOV.UK collection update history and current measure page reviewed.

title_zh: 欧盟发布2027年ETS1修订拍卖日历及首份ETS2拍卖日历
title_en: EU publishes revised 2027 ETS1 and initial ETS2 auction calendars
summary_zh: 欧委会10月1日确认EEX已发布2027年ETS1修订拍卖日历和首份ETS2拍卖日历。ETS1增加2500万份划拨希腊脱碳基金的配额；当前ETS2拍卖量含1.4亿份社会气候基金配额，年内还将因成员国立法进展调整。共同拍卖平台的ETS1和ETS2拍卖分别于2027年1月7日和1月18日开始。
summary_en: On 1 October the Commission confirmed EEX's revised 2027 ETS1 and first ETS2 auction calendars. ETS1 adds 25 million allowances for the Greek Decarbonisation Fund; the current ETS2 volume includes 140 million allowances for the Social Climate Fund and will be adjusted as national legislation progresses. Auctions start on 7 and 18 January 2027 respectively.
impact_zh: 跟踪判断：这是配额拍卖供应安排，不是钢铁CBAM证书价格、免费分配或清缴规则的调整。可作为2027年欧盟碳价和客户采购预算的市场信息跟踪，不应直接换算为钢材CBAM税额。
impact_en: Assessment: this concerns allowance auction supply, not a change to steel CBAM certificate pricing, free allocation or surrender rules. Use it as a 2027 carbon-market input, not as a direct steel CBAM charge.
coverage: Official DG CLIMA notice reviewed; linked EEX calendar was not treated as a change to CBAM legislation.

title_zh: 美国启动多项行政复审：涉及中国钢钉、制动鼓和金属储物柜
title_en: US opens administrative reviews covering Chinese steel nails, brake drums and metal lockers
summary_zh: 美国商务部10月1日启动8月周年月的反倾销/反补贴行政复审。其中对华涉钢项目包括钢钉A-570-909（复审期2025年8月1日至2026年7月31日）、制动鼓A-570-174/C-570-175及金属储物柜A-570-133/C-570-134。公告预计最终结果不晚于2027年8月31日。
summary_en: Commerce's 1 October omnibus notice opens August-anniversary AD/CVD reviews. China-related steel cases include steel nails A-570-909 (POR 1 August 2025–31 July 2026), brake drums A-570-174/C-570-175 and metal lockers A-570-133/C-570-134. Final results are intended by 31 August 2027.
impact_zh: 跟踪判断：被列名企业应让美国律师立即核对独立税率申请或证明、Q&V问卷及APO等个案期限；独立税率材料原则上须在公告后14个日历日内提交。此次是复审立案，不是新税率终裁。
impact_en: Assessment: listed firms should have US counsel check separate-rate applications/certifications, Q&V questionnaires and APO deadlines immediately. Separate-rate filings are generally due within 14 calendar days of publication. This is review initiation, not a new final rate.

follow_up.action_zh: 被列名企业由美国律师核对独立税率申请/证明及Q&V等实际提交期限
follow_up.action_en: US counsel to confirm case-specific separate-rate and Q&V filing deadlines.

coverage: Official Federal Register full notice reviewed; summary is limited to China-related steel cases in the omnibus tables.

title_zh: 美国扩大对华对焊管件反倾销令覆盖：越南后加工仍属中国原产范围
title_en: US Commerce brings China-formed butt-weld pipe fitting rough shapes processed in Vietnam within the AD order
summary_zh: 美国商务部公告（A-570-814；91 FR 55518）落实美国国际贸易法院2026年7月29日判决，自2026年8月8日起修正覆盖商品认定：中国境内切割并形成对焊管件粗坯的产品属于反倾销令范围内的“未制成品”；随后在越南完成第二、第三阶段加工，仍受对华碳钢对焊管件反倾销令约束。商务部将要求海关暂停相关成品和未制成品清算并按适用税率收取现金保证金。
summary_en: Commerce's notice (A-570-814; 91 FR 55518) implements the CIT's 29 July 2026 judgment and applies from 8 August 2026. Rough shapes cut to length and formed in China are unfinished butt-weld pipe fittings within the order; subsequent second- or third-stage processing in Vietnam does not remove them from the China AD order. CBP is to suspend liquidation and collect cash deposits at the applicable rate.
impact_zh: 事实与研判：这是法院判决后的覆盖范围修正，不是新立案或统一新税率。中国粗坯经越南后加工的供应链应立即核对报关、原产地和现金保证金安排，保存中国成形及越南加工阶段记录，并由美国律师确认具体条目适用税率与诉讼进展。
impact_en: Assessment: this is a court-driven scope amendment, not a new investigation or a uniform new duty rate. China-to-Vietnam processing chains should review entries, origin evidence and cash-deposit treatment, retain records for each processing stage, and have US counsel confirm the entry-specific rate and litigation status.
coverage: Official Federal Register full notice checked; no product-specific cash-deposit rate was inferred.

title_zh: 美国更正对华对焊管件公告：明确追溯暂停清算和现金保证金
title_en: US Commerce correction clarifies retroactive suspension for China-origin butt-weld pipe fittings processed in Vietnam
summary_zh: 美国商务部10月2日发布更正（A-570-814；91 FR 62700），补入8月28日公告遗漏的追溯执行段落。对在中国形成粗坯、在越南完成第二或第三阶段加工且物理特征相同的相关产品：已暂停的条目继续暂停并适用相应现金保证金；尚未暂停且未清算的条目，2022年9月26日及以后进口的须暂停清算并缴纳保证金；2021年11月4日之后、2022年9月26日之前进口且仍未清算的条目亦同。该认定按同一国家的出口商或进口商层面适用。
summary_en: Commerce's 2 October correction (A-570-814; 91 FR 62700) adds omitted retroactive implementation language to the 28 August notice. For China-formed rough shapes completed through second or third production stages in Vietnam and sharing the relevant physical characteristics, CBP is to continue existing suspensions and apply cash deposits; suspend still-unliquidated entries on or after 26 September 2022; and also suspend still-unliquidated entries after 4 November 2021 but before 26 September 2022, at the applicable rate. The finding applies on a country-wide exporter or importer basis.
impact_zh: 事实与研判：更正没有公布统一新税率，但显著扩大了需要追溯核对的未清算条目范围。相关出口商、越南加工商和美国进口商应立即按两个日期区间筛查历史未清算进口，核对保证金及海关指令，并保存粗坯物理特征、加工和原产链证据。
impact_en: Assessment: the correction sets no uniform new rate but materially clarifies the historical unliquidated entries subject to suspension. Exporters, Vietnamese processors and US importers should screen entries against both date windows, verify cash-deposit and CBP instructions, and preserve evidence on rough-shape characteristics, processing and origin.
coverage: Official Federal Register correction and the linked 28 August notice checked; date windows are limited to still-unliquidated covered entries.

title_zh: WTO成立欧盟CBAM争端专家组，中国保留第三方权利
title_en: WTO establishes panel on EU CBAM; China reserves third-party rights
summary_zh: WTO争端解决机构于2026年9月25日就俄罗斯诉欧盟案DS639成立专家组，审查欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）及俄罗斯所称欧盟排放交易体系下的出口补贴是否符合WTO义务。俄罗斯于2025年5月12日请求磋商、2026年7月10日请求设组；中国等成员保留第三方权利。专家组成立只是争端程序启动，尚无裁决。
summary_en: On 25 September 2026 the WTO DSB established a panel in DS639, Russia's challenge to the EU CBAM package and an alleged export subsidy under the EU ETS. Russia requested consultations on 12 May 2025 and a panel on 10 July 2026. China and other members reserved third-party rights. Panel establishment begins adjudication; no ruling has been issued.
impact_zh: 事实与研判：DS639不会自动暂停CBAM，欧盟现行申报、授权申报人和证书义务仍应照常准备。中国钢企可跟踪中国作为第三方提交的法律主张和后续报告，但当前不应据此延后碳数据、核证或客户合规安排。
impact_en: Assessment: DS639 does not automatically suspend CBAM. Existing EU reporting, authorised-declarant and certificate preparations should continue. Chinese steel exporters should monitor China's third-party submissions and later reports, but should not delay emissions-data, verification or customer-compliance work.
coverage: WTO DS639 case page and 25 September DSB news item checked; the collected media item is used only as the discovery record.

title_zh: 美国对华定尺碳钢板第五次日落复审终裁：撤令可能导致倾销延续
title_en: US fifth sunset review finds dumping likely to recur for Chinese cut-to-length carbon steel plate
summary_zh: 美国商务部第五次快速日落复审终裁（A-570-849；91 FR 63265）认定，撤销对中国和俄罗斯定尺碳钢板反倾销令可能导致倾销继续或再现；可能继续或再现的加权平均倾销幅度最高为中国128.59%、俄罗斯185.00%。由于没有被调查方提交实质答复，商务部采用120天快速复审程序；结果自2026年10月5日起适用。
summary_en: Commerce's expedited fifth sunset-review results (A-570-849; 91 FR 63265) find that revoking the China and Russia CTL-plate AD orders would likely lead to continuation or recurrence of dumping. Margins likely to prevail are up to 128.59% for China and 185.00% for Russia. No respondent interested party filed a substantive response, so Commerce used the 120-day expedited procedure. The results apply from 5 October 2026.
impact_zh: 事实与研判：128.59%是日落复审中的“可能继续或再现”幅度，不是所有中国出口商自本公告起统一适用的新现金保证金率。本公告支持维持现有反倾销令，但仍应跟踪USITC损害复审及后续续令公告；涉美定尺板业务应继续按企业适用税率报价，不应假设措施即将撤销。
impact_en: Assessment: 128.59% is the sunset-review margin likely to prevail, not a new uniform cash-deposit rate for every Chinese exporter. The finding supports continuation of the order, subject to the injury-side review and subsequent continuation notice. US CTL-plate business should keep using company-specific applicable rates and not assume the order will lapse.
coverage: Official Federal Register full notice reviewed, including final-results margins; the linked Issues and Decision Memorandum was not treated as separately reviewed.

title_zh: 美国初裁中国球墨铸铁制动鼓规避双反令，追溯至2026年1月27日
title_en: US preliminarily finds Chinese CGI brake drums circumvent AD/CVD orders
summary_zh: 美国商务部初步认定（A-570-174、C-570-175；91 FR 60082），中国制致密石墨铸铁（CGI）制动鼓属于后续发展商品，在全国范围规避对华制动鼓反倾销和反补贴令。调查产品内径14.75英寸至16.6英寸、重量超过50磅，包括公告所举M328D557型号。2026年1月27日及以后进入美国且尚未清算的条目将暂停清算；一般情况下按中国全国反倾销率150.25%和反补贴“其他企业”率11.94%收取保证金，已有企业单独税率的按其适用税率。
summary_en: Commerce preliminarily finds (A-570-174/C-570-175; 91 FR 60082) that Chinese compacted graphite iron brake drums are later-developed merchandise circumventing the China brake-drum AD/CVD orders on a country-wide basis. Covered inquiry merchandise has an inside diameter of 14.75–16.6 inches and weighs more than 50 pounds, including model M328D557. Unliquidated entries on or after 27 January 2026 are to be suspended; generally the China-wide AD rate is 150.25% and the CVD all-others rate 11.94%, while company-specific rates apply where available.
impact_zh: 事实与研判：这是规避调查初裁，不是最终结论，但已触发暂停清算和保证金要求。相关制造商、出口商和美国进口商应立即核对材质、尺寸、重量、型号及历史未清算条目；评论原则上于10月6日前、听证申请于10月22日前通过ACCESS提交，具体期限应由美国律师确认。
impact_en: Assessment: this is a preliminary circumvention finding, not a final determination, but suspension and cash-deposit requirements already apply. Producers, exporters and US importers should review material, dimensions, weight, model numbers and historical unliquidated entries. Comments are generally due 6 October and hearing requests 22 October; US counsel should confirm the filing dates.

follow_up.action_zh: 相关方由美国律师确认并提交评论；听证申请期限原则上为10月22日
follow_up.action_en: US counsel to confirm and file comments; hearing requests are generally due 22 October.

coverage: Official Federal Register full notice reviewed; listed rates are the stated order rates, not inferred transaction-specific liability.

title_zh: 美国初裁柬埔寨组装钢丝衣架规避中越贸易救济令
title_en: US preliminarily finds Cambodian-assembled steel wire hangers circumvent China and Vietnam orders
summary_zh: 美国商务部初步认定（A-570-918、A-552-812、C-552-813；91 FR 60086），在柬埔寨使用中国或越南产钢丝，或钢丝及纸配件完成并出口美国的钢丝衣架，在全国范围构成规避。2025年8月12日及以后进入美国且尚未清算的相关条目须暂停清算并缴纳保证金。未能按双重认证计划证明使用中国原料的，公告拟按越南全国反倾销率220.68%及反补贴其他企业率31.58%处理；证明使用中国原料的按对华衣架反倾销令适用税率处理。
summary_en: Commerce preliminarily finds (A-570-918/A-552-812/C-552-813; 91 FR 60086) that hangers completed in Cambodia from Chinese- or Vietnamese-origin steel wire, or steel wire and paper accessories, circumvent the respective orders on a country-wide basis. Relevant unliquidated entries on or after 12 August 2025 are suspended. Entries not certified under the dual program as using Chinese inputs are intended to face the Vietnam-wide AD rate of 220.68% plus the CVD all-others rate of 31.58%; certified Chinese-input entries use the applicable China hanger AD rate.
impact_zh: 事实与研判：这是初裁，但已产生追溯暂停清算、保证金和认证义务。中国钢丝经柬埔寨组装的供应链应核对原料原产、生产记录、ACE/DIS申报和第三国案号；历史未清算条目的认证及证明材料原则上最迟须在11月6日前完成，听证申请原则上10月22日前提交。Alpha Hanger、Everbrit和Kaining在本初裁下不能使用该认证。
impact_en: Assessment: although preliminary, the finding already creates retroactive suspension, cash-deposit and certification obligations. China-to-Cambodia supply chains should verify input origin, production records, ACE/DIS filings and third-country case numbers. Certifications for historical unliquidated entries are generally due by 6 November; hearing requests are generally due 22 October. Alpha Hanger, Everbrit and Kaining are ineligible for the certification under this preliminary finding.

follow_up.action_zh: 相关方由美国律师确认听证申请；历史条目认证及证明材料原则上于11月6日前完成
follow_up.action_en: US counsel to confirm hearing request; historical-entry certifications and evidence are generally due by 6 November.

coverage: Official Federal Register full notice and certification requirements reviewed; company eligibility and entry treatment remain subject to the preliminary determination and CBP/Commerce instructions.

title_zh: 欧盟公布2026年第三季度CBAM证书价格：82.32欧元
title_en: EU publishes Q3 2026 CBAM certificate price of €82.32
summary_zh: 欧委会10月5日公布2026年第三季度CBAM证书价格为每张82.32欧元；第二季度为75.28欧元，环比上升约9.4%。季度价格按欧盟碳排放配额拍卖成交价加权平均计算，适用于对应季度进口CBAM商品的隐含排放；2026年证书从2027年2月起在统一中央平台购买。
summary_en: On 5 October the Commission published the Q3 2026 CBAM certificate price at €82.32, about 9.4% above Q2's €75.28. The quarterly price is the weighted average of EU ETS auction clearing prices and applies to embedded emissions in CBAM goods imported during the relevant quarter; 2026 certificates become purchasable on the common central platform from February 2027.
impact_zh: 事实与研判：钢铁出口商应把82.32欧元作为第三季度对应证书的官方价格输入，与欧盟进口商更新碳成本测算和合同调价假设；它不是钢材吨税，也不能脱离经核验的产品隐含排放、免费分配调整和已支付碳价直接换算应缴额。
impact_en: Assessment: use €82.32 as the official certificate-price input for Q3 and update carbon-cost and contract assumptions with EU importers. It is not a per-tonne steel tariff and cannot determine liability without verified embedded emissions, free-allocation adjustment and eligible carbon prices already paid.
coverage: Official DG TAXUD price table and methodology page checked on 5 October 2026.

title_zh: 欧盟对中国和土耳其焊接钢丝网进口实施登记
title_en: EU requires registration of welded steel mesh imports from China and Türkiye
summary_zh: 欧盟实施条例(EU) 2026/2022自2026年9月12日起生效，要求海关登记原产于中国和土耳其的交点焊接普通钢丝格栅、网片、网和围栏，不论是否镀锌、涂层或卷装，现列CN 7314 20 90、7314 31 00和7314 39 00。登记为期9个月，目的是在法定条件满足时允许追溯征收反倾销税。
summary_en: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/2022 took effect on 12 September 2026 and directs customs authorities to register welded-at-intersection grill, mesh, netting and fencing of plain wire from China and Türkiye, whether plated, coated, galvanised or in rolls, currently under CN 7314 20 90, 7314 31 00 and 7314 39 00. Registration lasts nine months and may support retroactive duties if the legal conditions are met.
impact_zh: 事实与研判：登记不是反倾销终裁，也未确定实际税率。投诉材料中的中国倾销幅度26%至73%、损害消除水平18%仅供现阶段参考。涉欧订单应自9月12日起单列登记进口、保存产品规格和报关记录，并在报价中保留追溯征税条款。
impact_en: Assessment: registration is not a final anti-dumping determination and sets no actual duty rate. Complaint estimates of 26–73% dumping and an 18% injury-elimination level for China are informational only. Segregate registered EU entries from 12 September, preserve specifications and customs records, and address retroactive-duty risk in contracts.
coverage: Official EUR-Lex full text checked, including product scope, CN codes, registration purpose and nine-month duration.
follow_up: 跟踪反倾销调查临时/终裁及是否追溯征税；现行登记期最长至2027-06-12。

title_zh: 欧盟对中国钢制货架及部件进口实施登记
title_en: EU requires registration of Chinese steel shelving units and components
summary_zh: 欧盟实施条例(EU) 2026/2023自2026年9月12日起生效，要求登记中国原产的螺栓式和无螺栓钢制货架及部件，包括具有两个平面连接面的钢立柱、无焊接立柱连接件的钢横梁，以及包含上述部件的货架（可有或无任何材质层板）。现列CN ex 9403 20 80、ex 9403 99 10，TARIC 9403 20 80 20、9403 99 10 20；登记为期9个月。
summary_en: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/2023 took effect on 12 September 2026 and requires registration of Chinese bolted and boltless steel shelving units and components, including steel uprights with two flat connecting surfaces, steel beams without welded upright connectors and shelving containing those components, with or without decks of any material. Current codes are CN ex 9403 20 80 and ex 9403 99 10, TARIC 9403 20 80 20 and 9403 99 10 20; registration lasts nine months.
impact_zh: 事实与研判：登记不等于已征税，投诉中的62%至103%倾销幅度和290%至310%损害消除水平不是最终税率。中国货架供应商及欧盟进口商应从9月12日起筛查对应TARIC条目，留存产品结构、连接方式和进口记录，并在合同中安排可能追溯征税的承担机制。
impact_en: Assessment: registration does not itself impose a duty. Complaint estimates of 62–103% dumping and 290–310% injury elimination are not final rates. Chinese suppliers and EU importers should screen the listed TARIC entries from 12 September, retain product-structure and import records, and allocate potential retroactive-duty risk contractually.
coverage: Official EUR-Lex full text checked, including scope wording, CN/TARIC codes, registration purpose and duration.
follow_up: 跟踪反倾销调查临时/终裁及是否追溯征税；现行登记期最长至2027-06-12。

title_zh: 欧盟给予嘉善Carrey紧固件39.6%新出口商反倾销税率
title_en: EU grants Carrey Intelligent Manufacturing the 39.6% new-exporter fastener duty rate
summary_zh: 欧盟实施条例(EU) 2026/2089确认Carrey Intelligent Manufacturing (Jiashan) Co., Ltd.满足新出口生产商待遇条件，并将其列入(EU) 2022/191附件，TARIC附加码88FN，适用未抽样合作企业39.6%的反倾销税率。该公司2022年成立、2023年获出口许可，并于2025年开始向欧盟出口涉案铁或钢制紧固件；条例自2026年9月22日起生效。
summary_en: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/2089 confirms that Carrey Intelligent Manufacturing (Jiashan) Co., Ltd. meets the new-exporting-producer conditions and adds it to the annex to Regulation (EU) 2022/191 under TARIC additional code 88FN, applying the 39.6% rate for cooperating non-sampled producers. The company was founded in 2022, obtained an export licence in 2023 and began EU exports of the fasteners in 2025. The amendment took effect on 22 September 2026.
impact_zh: 事实与研判：39.6%是该公司凭88FN适用的企业特定待遇，不代表中国紧固件普遍降税；原措施中抽样企业税率22.1%至48.8%，未合作全国税率86.5%。出口和进口申报应准确使用生产商身份及附加码，并核对发票、产地和关联关系证据。
impact_en: Assessment: 39.6% is company-specific treatment linked to additional code 88FN, not a general reduction for Chinese fasteners. The original measure ranges from 22.1–48.8% for sampled producers and 86.5% country-wide for non-cooperators. Declarations should use the correct producer identity and code and retain invoice, origin and affiliation evidence.
coverage: Official EUR-Lex full text checked, including eligibility findings, company identity, duty rate, TARIC additional code and entry into force.

title_zh: 英国CBAM：合格碳定价制度名单包含中国全国碳市场
title_en: UK CBAM: qualifying scheme list includes China's national ETS
summary_zh: HMRC于8月27日发布准备期名单，依据截至6月19日的信息列入中国全国碳市场、EU ETS等16项制度；名单非穷尽并将更新。可抵扣金额取决于货物承担的有效碳价：免费配额覆盖的排放不抵扣，返还或补贴须扣减，全部免费或全额返还时可能无抵扣。
summary_en: HMRC's 27 August preparatory list includes China's national ETS among 16 schemes, using information as of 19 June. It is non-exhaustive. Relief depends on the effective price paid; free allocation and refunds can reduce relief to zero.
impact_zh: 对中国钢厂：纳入名单不等于每吨钢自动抵扣全国碳市场报价。应准备装置、履约付款、免费配额及返还资料，与英国进口商和核验方建立货物有效碳价证据链。
impact_en: Listing does not create an automatic per-tonne deduction. Gather installation, payment, free-allocation and refund evidence with the UK importer and verifier.
coverage: 已核对官方名单正文；未逐项审计各制度及2026年法规全文。

title_zh: 英国CBAM：碳价抵扣须满足政府管理、法定参与等全部条件
title_en: UK CBAM: all qualifying carbon-pricing criteria must be met
summary_zh: 8月28日更新的HMRC指南要求制度由政府或超国家组织管理、控制收入用途，法定要求相关生产装置参与，公开规则、范围及标价，并对排放施加直接或符合规定方法的间接碳价。低于强制门槛但自愿加入合格制度的装置仍可能符合条件；自愿碳定价制度及按燃料体积或重量征收的固定税不符合。
summary_en: The updated guide requires government administration and revenue control, mandatory participation, public rules and prices, and qualifying direct or indirect emissions pricing. Voluntary entry into a qualifying mandatory scheme differs from a voluntary carbon-pricing scheme; flat fuel duties do not qualify.
impact_zh: 核对工厂所参加制度是否合格，再取得碳价核验表。不要用自愿碳信用购买或普通燃料税代替合格履约成本。
impact_en: Check scheme eligibility and obtain carbon-pricing verification. Voluntary credits and ordinary flat fuel taxes are not substitutes for qualifying costs.
coverage: 已核对官方正文；仅总结本页，不表示已阅读全文所链接的法规或附件。

title_zh: 欧委会2025贸易救济报告：32项新调查，钢铁仍是重点领域
title_en: EU 2025 trade defence report: 32 new investigations, steel remains a focus
summary_zh: 欧委会9月18日新闻称，9月17日通过的年度报告记录2025年启动32项调查、实施26项最终措施；年末有效措施232项，其中220项为最终措施。钢铁和化工的贸易救济需求突出，3案追溯实施措施；进口监测工作组跟踪因第三国高关税而转向欧盟的贸易。
summary_en: The Commission's news reports 32 investigations opened and 26 definitive measures imposed in 2025, with 232 measures in force at year-end, 220 definitive. Iron and steel remain prominent. Three cases involved retroactivity, and surveillance monitors trade diversion.
impact_zh: 这是年度执法回顾，未给中国钢材统一新增税率。出口团队应按具体产品和企业跟踪调查，保留价格、生产商及原产地资料，关注进口登记和追溯风险。
impact_en: This annual review creates no uniform new steel duty. Track product- and producer-specific cases and preserve pricing and origin evidence, including registration and retroactivity risks.
coverage: 已核对官方正文；仅总结本页，不表示已阅读全文所链接的法规或附件。

title_zh: 英国CBAM注册路线：2027年起适用，门槛为进口金额£50,000
title_en: UK CBAM registration roadmap: £50,000 threshold from 2027
summary_zh: HMRC注册集合页说明，2027年1月1日起进口指定铝、水泥、化肥、氢、钢铁产品须评估责任。依次核对税号、责任进口人、门槛排除情形和注册起算日；货值超过或预计超过£50,000须按规则注册。注册服务最迟2028年1月1日开放，此前已产生责任仍须保存记录。
summary_en: From 1 January 2027, importers of specified goods must assess liability using commodity codes, importer status, exclusions and registration timing. The value threshold is £50,000. Registration opens by 1 January 2028; earlier liability still requires records.
impact_zh: 提前与英国客户确认责任主体、年度采购计划和记录交付；不要将注册平台开放时间误当税制开始时间，也不要混用欧盟50吨门槛。
impact_en: Agree importer responsibilities and evidence delivery now. Platform opening is not the start of liability, and the EU's 50-tonne threshold is different.
coverage: 已核对官方正文；仅总结本页，不表示已阅读全文所链接的法规或附件。

title_zh: 英国CBAM：私人用途、退运及特殊海关程序如何影响注册门槛
title_en: UK CBAM: exclusions and special procedures for the registration threshold
summary_zh: HMRC指南列明私人用途、英国原产、符合退运减免及全额关税减免临时进口等排除情形。特殊程序货物释放为英国自由流通且应缴关税时可计入门槛；进境加工成CBAM货物计全值，加工成非CBAM货物仍计原CBAM部分价值，境外加工回运按规定价值差额计入。
summary_en: The guide explains exclusions for private use, UK origin, returned-goods relief and fully relieved temporary admission. Release into free circulation can trigger inclusion. Inward processing has distinct rules for CBAM and non-CBAM outputs; outward processing can use the value difference.
impact_zh: 中国钢材商业采购不因先入海关仓库就永久免CBAM。报价和供应链设计应核对最终用途、海关程序及释放时点，保留减免证据。
impact_en: Commercial steel is not permanently exempt merely because it enters warehousing. Check end use, customs discharge and supporting relief evidence.
coverage: 已核对官方正文；仅总结本页，不表示已阅读全文所链接的法规或附件。

title_zh: 英国CBAM钢铁范围：第72章及指定73章制品，废钢等有排除
title_en: UK CBAM iron and steel scope: chapter 72 and specified chapter 73 goods
summary_en: The steel list covers 260112, chapter 72, 7301–7311, 7318 and 7326 for CO₂, excluding 7204 scrap and specified ferro-alloy codes. Confirm the complete commodity code and description.
impact_zh: 热轧、冷轧、镀层板及板坯客户应建立英国税号映射，不照搬欧盟清单；范围判断不等于确定税额或原产地结论。
impact_en: Map slab and flat-steel products to UK codes. Do not assume the EU list applies or infer tax amounts from scope alone.
coverage: 已核对官方钢铁行业完整清单；其他行业附件未读。

title_zh: 英国：对中国及俄罗斯部分冷轧板的旧反倾销措施于8月5日到期
title_en: UK: historical cold-rolled steel anti-dumping measure expired on 5 August
summary_zh: 英国官方集合页及2022/04公告明确：部分冷轧平板反倾销税于2026年8月5日到期，2022/04公告不再适用。历史范围为未镀覆、加工不超过冷轧的非不锈钢平板，并排除部分电工钢、黑板及高速钢；旧税率表是历史信息。
summary_en: The official collection and notice 2022/04 expressly state that the cold-rolled measure expired on 5 August 2026 and no longer applies. The historical product scope excludes specified electrical steel, black plate and high-speed steel; old duty tables are historical.
impact_zh: 英国冷轧业务应更新报价税负底表，勿继续套用旧22.1%余项税率。仍需核对当前英国税则、配额措施及任何后续新措施；不能据此判断欧盟反倾销税到期。
impact_en: Update UK cold-rolled costing and stop treating the historical 22.1% residual rate as current. Check current UK tariffs and quotas; this does not imply EU duties have expired.
coverage: 已核对集合页到期更新及2022/04公告正文；未将历史税率作现行税率。

title_zh: 英国2026/26：延长中国线材反倾销税，7.9%或24%；到期表述待澄清
title_en: UK notice 2026/26 extends Chinese wire-rod duties; expiry wording needs clarification
summary_zh: 9月10日公告、9月11日生效，延长中国热轧盘条反倾销措施并调整描述：铁、非合金或除不锈钢外合金钢不规则盘卷。华菱集团7.9%（A930），其他24%（A999），特定税率需合格发票声明。所列税号为72131000、72132000、72139110/20/41/49/70/90、72139910/90、72271000、72272000、72279010/50/95。公告复审段写2031年1月30日，期限段却写1月28日且误称反补贴税。
summary_en: Notice 2026/26 extends duties on Chinese hot-rolled wire rod: Valin 7.9% (A930), residual 24% (A999), subject to invoice conditions. It covers listed 7213 and 7227 codes. The review text and expiry section conflict on 28 versus 30 January 2031, with inconsistent duty terminology.
impact_zh: 当前报价按企业税率和产品范围核对；2031最终到期日须由TRA/HMRC澄清，不将正文冲突自行抹平。中国其他钢厂不可套用华菱税率。
impact_en: Check product scope, producer and invoice conditions. Seek official clarification of the conflicting 2031 expiry dates; other mills cannot assume Valin's rate.
coverage: 已核对2026/26正文和税率表；到期日期及术语存在原文矛盾，待官方澄清。

title_zh: 欧委会发布CBAM正式期十份指南：非欧盟钢厂需衔接排放与免费配额调整
title_en: Commission publishes ten definitive-period CBAM guidance documents
summary_zh: 8月14日官方新闻说明十份指南由四份通用和六份行业指南组成，覆盖概念与合规周期、非欧盟生产者路线、内含排放计算、EU ETS免费配额调整及钢铁等行业。面向境外生产装置、授权申报人和核验机构。
summary_en: The 14 August news introduces four general and six sector guides covering the compliance cycle, non-EU operators, emissions, free-allocation adjustment and sector methods including iron and steel.
impact_zh: 中国钢厂应组织制造、碳数据和出口团队联合阅读钢铁指南及方法文件，形成给进口商的统一数据包。本条只核对发布新闻；具体公式、边界和示例仍需读PDF，不能据新闻计算税额。
impact_en: Coordinate manufacturing, carbon-data and export teams to read the steel and methodological guides. This news-level review does not verify PDF formulas or permit tax calculations.
coverage: 已核对官方正文；仅总结本页，不表示已阅读全文所链接的法规或附件。

title_zh: EU ETS：修订2026及发布2027拍卖日历，MSR继续收紧供给
title_en: EU ETS: revised 2026 and new 2027 auction calendars published
summary_zh: 7月30日官方新闻称，2026年9月至2027年8月有190,494,202份配额进入市场稳定储备。2027共同平台周一、二、四拍卖，自1月7日开始；德国周五自1月8日、波兰隔周三自1月13日。RRF拍卖已于6—7月完成，日历不再包含后续RRF拍卖。
summary_en: DG CLIMA reports 190,494,202 allowances entering the MSR from September 2026 to August 2027. Common-platform auctions start 7 January 2027; Germany 8 January and Poland 13 January. RRF auctions finished in June–July 2026.
impact_zh: 拍卖供给变化是EUA及未来CBAM价格的跟踪变量，但不保证价格单向上涨；采购决策需结合需求、能源及实际清算价。本条核对官方新闻，未逐日检查EEX附件数量。
impact_en: Auction supply is an EUA/CBAM monitoring input, not proof of a price rise. Combine it with demand, energy and clearing prices; individual EEX calendar rows were not audited.
coverage: 已核对官方正文；仅总结本页，不表示已阅读全文所链接的法规或附件。

title_zh: 美国：更正中国拉制不锈钢水槽日落复审余项补贴率为8.51%
title_en: US corrects Chinese drawn stainless-steel sink sunset-review rate to 8.51%
summary_zh: 10月6日公告2026-20481纠正2018和2023两次反补贴日落复审终裁中的错误：其他企业补贴率原写8.61%，应为8.51%。这是历史公告数字更正，不是对所有中国钢材新增税率。
summary_en: Notice 2026-20481 corrects the all-others subsidy rate in the 2018 and 2023 sunset results from 8.61% to 8.51%. It is a correction of historical notices.
impact_zh: 水槽出口及美国进口商应更新案件档案，由律师核对现行保证金、清算指令及历史记录，不能直接把8.51%当所有企业当前税率。
impact_en: Update case records and have counsel check current deposits and liquidation instructions. Do not apply 8.51% indiscriminately.
coverage: 已核对Federal Register正文及公开审阅PDF；未核对各企业当前CBP保证金指令。

title_zh: 欧盟2026/1788：删除两项误留紧固件税号，相关反倾销税可按海关法退还
title_en: EU 2026/1788 removes erroneous fastener codes and provides repayment
summary_zh: 条例删除7318220031和7318220095两项源于马来西亚发运反规避措施的TARIC编码：该旧措施2016年到期，但编码误留，导致自2022年无有效法律依据征税。7月25日生效、追溯自2022年2月18日适用；第2条规定相关已缴税依海关法退还。
summary_en: The regulation deletes TARIC 7318220031 and 7318220095, retained from an expired Malaysian-consignment measure. It applies retroactively from 18 February 2022 and provides repayment under customs law.
impact_zh: 原看板把这项修订解释成加强贸易限制，现予纠正。进口商应筛查相关历史报关与税单、核对退税期限；其他中国紧固件反倾销措施仍需逐项核对。
impact_en: Corrects the earlier restrictive interpretation. Screen historical entries and repayment deadlines; other fastener measures must be checked separately.
coverage: 已核对条例序言及第1—3条正文。

title_zh: EU ETS：德国2022关停电厂对应2024年度配额本轮无需另行注销
title_en: EU ETS: Germany needs no additional cancellation for 2024 linked to 2022 closures
summary_zh: 9月4日通知解释，德国两处2022年关停发电设施对应2024年度拟注销量为零。因2025年TNAC在MSR缓冲区，MSR已移除关停造成的2024年剩余配额，无需额外国别注销；2025年对2023年度的注销情况不同。
summary_en: DG CLIMA explains that no national cancellation is needed for the 2024 year because the MSR removes the relevant surplus while 2025 TNAC is in its buffer zone. The prior year's treatment was different.
impact_zh: 不能仅凭标题认定德国本轮额外收紧供给。EUA分析应区分MSR吸收与国家注销，避免重复计算供给减少。
impact_en: Do not infer extra supply tightening from the headline. Separate MSR absorption from national cancellation.
coverage: 已核对官方新闻正文；未逐一读取德文通知附件。

title_zh: CBAM核验指南：获认可后两个月内注册，2027年起在登记册出报告
title_en: CBAM verifier guidance: register within two months of accreditation
summary_zh: 8月24日官方新闻说明：国家认可机构认可为第一步，随后申请CBAM登记册访问并由主管机关核验资格。核验机构须获CBAM认可后两个月内注册，且不早于2026年9月1日；从2027年1月起在登记册签发核验报告。
summary_en: Accreditation precedes Registry access, with competent-authority checks. Verifiers must register within two months of CBAM accreditation, no earlier than 1 September 2026, and issue reports in the Registry from January 2027.
impact_zh: 钢厂签约核验机构时应核对CBAM认可范围与登记册准备情况，不以普通ISO证书或预认证代替正式资格。
impact_en: Check CBAM accreditation scope and Registry readiness; ordinary ISO certificates or pre-certification do not substitute for the required status.
coverage: 已核对官方发布新闻及登记流程说明；本条不表示141页指南全部已核验。

title_zh: 美国钢格栅反补贴日落复审：认定撤销措施可能导致再发生
title_en: US steel grating countervailing sunset review finds likely recurrence
summary_zh: 美国商务部快速日落复审结果认为，撤销中国钢格栅反补贴税令可能导致倾销或可反补贴补贴延续或再发生。公告列示复审判断水平为62.46%（宁波九龙及其他企业）。这属于商务部日落复审结果，非各企业现行保证金或单票综合税率表。
summary_en: Commerce's expedited sunset result finds likely recurrence if the Chinese steel grating order is revoked. The stated review level is 62.46% for Ningbo Jiulong and all other producers. These are sunset-review findings, not a universal current deposit schedule.
impact_zh: 相关出口商须跟踪USITC损害复审及后续续征公告，按准确产品范围和生产商核对现行现金保证金。不得直接叠加复审百分比估算综合进口税。
impact_en: Track USITC injury reviews and continuation notices. Check product scope and current producer-specific deposits; do not add sunset percentages into an import-cost estimate.
coverage: 已核对发布机关网页的摘要、结果及相关核心段落；未读ACCESS决定备忘录，不据此认定当前企业现金保证金。

title_zh: 美国钢格栅反倾销日落复审：认定撤销措施可能导致再发生
title_en: US steel grating antidumping sunset review finds likely recurrence

title_zh: 美国预应力混凝土钢绞线反倾销日落复审：认定撤销措施可能导致再发生
title_en: US prestressed concrete steel strand antidumping sunset review finds likely recurrence
summary_zh: 美国商务部快速日落复审结果认为，撤销中国预应力混凝土钢绞线反倾销税令可能导致倾销或可反补贴补贴延续或再发生。公告列示复审判断水平为最高193.55%。这属于商务部日落复审结果，非各企业现行保证金或单票综合税率表。

impact_zh: 相关出口商须跟踪USITC损害复审及后续续征公告，按准确产品范围和生产商核对现行现金保证金。不得直接叠加复审百分比估算综合进口税。

title_zh: 美国预应力混凝土钢绞线反补贴日落复审：认定撤销措施可能导致再发生
title_en: US prestressed concrete steel strand countervailing sunset review finds likely recurrence
summary_zh: 美国商务部快速日落复审结果认为，撤销中国预应力混凝土钢绞线反补贴税令可能导致倾销或可反补贴补贴延续或再发生。公告列示复审判断水平为Fasten企业组9.42%、Xinhua企业组45.85%、其他27.64%。这属于商务部日落复审结果，非各企业现行保证金或单票综合税率表。

title_zh: 美国不可重复充装钢瓶反补贴日落复审：认定撤销措施可能导致再发生
title_en: US non-refillable steel cylinders countervailing sunset review finds likely recurrence
summary_zh: 美国商务部快速日落复审结果认为，撤销中国不可重复充装钢瓶反补贴税令可能导致倾销或可反补贴补贴延续或再发生。公告列示复审判断水平为宁波Eagle 25.91%、武义Xilinde 18.37%、公告列明7家企业186.18%、其他21.28%。这属于商务部日落复审结果，非各企业现行保证金或单票综合税率表。

title_en: CBAM guidance 3: annual calculation, process boundaries and scrap data
summary_zh: 8月14日非约束性指南明确正式期以生产日历年为基准；同一装置相同功能单位而不同生产路线的货物须按规定平均，生产过程划分不能只看CN编码。第4.9节说明钢铁活动水平用货物吨数，并要求提供合金元素、废钢量和其中消费前废钢比例等信息。
summary_en: The non-binding guide uses calendar-year production data and prescribed averaging for the same functional unit across routes. Process definition is not based solely on CN codes. Steel reporting includes mass, alloy and scrap information.
impact_zh: 高废钢产品不能仅凭单票名称或TARIC号单独认定低碳值。工厂应记录实际投入、年度产量和过程边界，与核验方确认可分列条件；不能据本要点直接测算税額。
impact_en: A high-scrap label or tariff code alone does not establish a separate low-carbon value. Document inputs, annual output and boundaries with the verifier.
coverage: 已核对PDF封面、版本、目录，第2章方法变更表及第4.9节活动水平/品质数据相关段落；147页未逐页核验，未复算示例。

title_zh: CBAM核验认可指南：现场访问原则及有条件例外
title_en: CBAM verification guide: physical site visits and conditional exceptions
summary_zh: 8月24日指南第4.9节要求核验方通过现场访问检查装置和过程边界、排放源、计量及控制系统。虚拟访问或豁免须满足规定条件和风险评估，不能两种例外叠加。原文列示可采用首次实地、次年虚拟交替，或连续两年实地后第三年豁免的安排，仍须满足其他条件。
summary_en: Section 4.9 requires physical checks of boundaries, sources and monitoring. Virtual visits and waivers require stated conditions and risk assessment and cannot be combined cumulatively. The guide gives conditional alternating or third-year waiver patterns.
impact_zh: 钢厂应为核验安排现场准入、仪表及数据流程证据，不把远程审核当默认权利。初次核验、过程重大变更或证据不足应与核验方确认实地要求。
impact_en: Plan site access and monitoring evidence. Remote auditing is not a default entitlement; confirm requirements for initial checks and material process changes.
coverage: 已核对PDF目录及第4.9节（印刷页59—62）现场访问、例外及证据要求；未逐页核验141页全文或全部认可细则。

title_zh: 美国螺纹杆复审终裁：三组中国出口商适用0.74%倾销幅度

summary_en: For the April 2024–March 2025 review, Jinding/Dingtuo, Dongxin and Junyue receive 0.74%; the China-wide rate remains 48.91%. Listed firms' deposits apply from 17 July. Historical assessment can be importer-specific.

impact_en: Match exporter identities, case numbers and entries. Distinguish future deposits from historical assessment and verify other applicable duties.

title_zh: 美国启动泰国耐腐蚀钢反规避调查，涉及中国原料加工后输美
title_en: US opens country-wide circumvention inquiry into Thai CORE using Chinese components
summary_zh: A-570-026/C-570-027自2026年7月6日启动全国性反规避调查，范围为使用中国原产组件在泰国完成加工、再出口美国的耐腐蚀钢产品。商务部将审查加工程度、投资、价值、采购及贸易变化；初步和最终决定计划分别在立案后150天、300天内作出，可延期。本公告维持已被暂停清算货物的相应安排，并非对全部泰国货物作出规避终裁。
summary_en: The 6 July country-wide inquiry covers Thai-finished CORE using Chinese components. Commerce plans preliminary and final decisions within 150 and 300 days, subject to extension. Initiation is not a final finding covering all Thai shipments.
impact_zh: 中国原料供应商和泰国加工商应保存炉号、投入产出、加工成本、投资与销售链资料并及时应诉。需按货物与现有清算状态评估风险，不能仅凭立案推导统一税额。
impact_en: Preserve input traceability, processing costs, investment and sales-chain records; assess shipment-specific exposure rather than assuming a uniform new duty.
coverage: 已核对Federal Register公告正文相关范围、结论和程序条款；未阅读另附ACCESS决定备忘录，完整产品范围及后续海关指令需单独核对。

title_zh: 美国不可重复充装钢瓶复审初裁：武义西林德218.88%，尚非终裁保证金

summary_zh: 7月24日公布的实施条例(EU)2026/1785将Zhejiang Yitai Mechanical Technology Co., Ltd列入2022/191未抽样合作企业名单，TARIC附加代码88ES，反倾销税率39.6%，公布翌日生效。申请满足原调查期2019年7月1日至2020年6月30日未对欧出口、无相关受措施企业关联、调查期后实际出口三项条件；不是取消中国紧固件整体反倾销税。
summary_en: Published 24 July and effective the next day, Regulation 2026/1785 adds Zhejiang Yitai to the non-sampled cooperating fastener producers at 39.6%, TARIC code 88ES. It is company-specific new-exporter treatment.
impact_zh: 该企业及进口商应核对英文法人名称、88ES与商业发票要求。其他新出口企业可评估资格证据，但不得套用他人附加代码或39.6%税率。
impact_en: Match the legal producer identity, 88ES and invoice requirements; other exporters cannot use this company's code or rate.
coverage: 已核对2026/1785条例正文；完整产品范围及发票条件仍按其引用的2022/191及后续修订核对。

title_zh: 欧盟2026/1457：钢铁配额按国家和季度分配，现行实施期至12月31日
title_en: EU 2026/1457 distributes steel quotas by origin and quarter through 31 December
summary_zh: 实施条例(EU)2026/1457自7月1日至12月31日适用，落实2026/1384的26类钢材配额。普通最惠国部分与FTA部分资格不同，中国不得因转运取得FTA资格；先到先得、非优惠原产地规则适用。附件例：中国3B类非取向电工钢CN72251990/72261980年度47,351.25吨、每季11,837.81吨，配额号09.9828；表列超配额附加税50%。此数为法规分配量，非实时余额。
summary_en: Regulation 2026/1457 applies July–December 2026 with origin-specific MFN/FTA quotas and first-come-first-served access. China's category 3B allocation is 47,351.25 tonnes annually and 11,837.81 quarterly, order 09.9828; the listed out-of-quota duty is 50%, not a live balance.
impact_zh: 输欧订单应逐项匹配CN、原产地、配额号及报关时余额，区分中国专属与剩余配额；合同约定超配额风险。12月底前跟进替代实施条例，不能把本条例自动延续到2027年。
impact_en: Match CN, origin and order numbers to live customs balances; allocate quota risk contractually and track replacement rules before year-end.
coverage: 已核对正文第1–6条、附件表头和中国3B类别；未逐行核算全部类别及实时配额余额，2026/1384主条例正文遇访问验证墙。

follow_up.zh: 跟进2027年配额分配实施条例；本条例适用期截至2026-12-31。
follow_up.en: Track the successor quota-distribution act before the current act expires on 31 December.

title_zh: 美国中国无缝钢管第三次日落复审：10月16日可提交答复充分性评论
title_en: US seamless pipe sunset reviews: adequacy comments due 16 October
summary_zh: USITC于8月3日启动701-TA-469/731-TA-1168第三次五年复审，判断撤销中国无缝碳钢和合金钢标准管、管线管及压力管双反令是否会导致损害继续或再现。答复截止9月2日已过；答复充分性评论截止10月16日。原产品界定涉及外径不超过16英寸的相关无缝管，完整范围以商务部命令为准；本通知不是撤销令或新税率终裁。
summary_en: USITC instituted third sunset reviews 701-TA-469/731-TA-1168 on 3 August. Responses were due 2 September; adequacy comments are due 16 October. This is an injury-review initiation, not revocation or a new duty rate.
impact_zh: 相关出口商和进口商应立即与案件律师核对是否具备评论资格及EDIS提交要求，在10月16日前处理充分性意见；不能因启动日落复审认定现行措施失效。
impact_en: Check eligibility and EDIS requirements with counsel before 16 October; initiation does not mean existing orders have expired.
coverage: 已核对USITC立案公告的范围、日期、参与程序；未核对EDIS案件后续修改或企业已提交答复。

follow_up.zh: 答复充分性评论截止日；具体提交时刻及资格请核对EDIS及律师通知。
follow_up.en: Adequacy-comment deadline; confirm filing time and eligibility in EDIS.

title_zh: 英国10月1日钢铁新规修订：两项非合金钢丝税号移出措施范围
title_en: UK 1 October steel-measure amendment excludes two non-alloy wire codes
summary_zh: 英国官方页面10月1日更新，移除非合金钢丝税号72173049、72173090，将这两项措施税率从50%降至0%，第28类配额量不变。其余7月1日起执行的20类钢材制度总体配额较旧保障措施减少51%，超配额税率50%；旧25%保障措施于6月30日停止。第1类热轧板带还有授权用途安排，乌克兰原产货物适用单独优惠条件。
summary_en: The 1 October update removes wire codes 72173049 and 72173090, reducing their measure rate from 50% to 0% without changing category 28 quotas. The July regime otherwise reduces overall quotas by 51% with a 50% out-of-quota tariff across 20 categories. Category 1 has authorised-use arrangements; Ukraine has separate origin-conditioned preferences.
impact_zh: 钢丝出口商应立即核对归类与新报价；移出本措施不等于免除所有其他关税或贸易救济。其他钢材订单须核对配额、原产地和授权用途，尤其热轧第1类，不能直接套用旧25%费率。本研判仅适用10月1日版本，旧7月2日记录不套用新版结论。
impact_en: Wire exporters should check classification and quotations immediately. Exclusion does not remove other applicable duties. Other shipments require quota, origin and authorised-use checks. This brief applies only to the 1 October revision.
coverage: 已核对官方说明的10月1日修订、产品范围及配额表；未逐项核算20类报关税负，实时余额须以英国海关为准。

title_zh: CBAM证书销售与回购草案：咨询已于8月6日结束
title_en: CBAM certificate sale/repurchase draft: feedback closed 6 August
summary_zh: 7月9日发布的授权法规草案拟规定共同中央平台的证书销售与回购，包括时间、管理、收费结构及平台运行。官方API显示征求意见于2026年8月6日结束，当前记录未列采纳日期；不能由咨询关闭推断已生效。
summary_en: The 9 July draft concerns certificate sale and repurchase via the common central platform, including administration and fees. Feedback closed 6 August; the API lists no adoption date.
impact_zh: 进口商应准备购证账户、现金流及内部审批；钢厂提供排放资料。平台收费和回购操作须按最终正式文本核对，不能依据倡议摘要确定成本。
impact_en: Prepare importer cash-flow and account processes; verify final platform fees and repurchase rules in the adopted text.
coverage: 2026-10-09核对欧委会官方API dossierSummary及publications程序信息；未核读草案/采纳法案和附件全文，仅完成倡议摘要与状态核验，不作为当前完整法规研判。

title_zh: 欧盟钢铁生态设计倡议：低碳定义与循环性要求仍待正式文本
title_en: EU steel ecodesign initiative: low-carbon definition and circularity rules pending
summary_zh: 5月20日发布的倡议拟定义低碳钢、提出钢铁产品可持续与循环设计要求，并改善相关信息获取，关联清洁工业协议、钢铁金属行动计划及工业加速器提案。已启动的公众咨询于8月12日结束；API仍标示后续草案阶段待启动，未列采纳日期。
summary_en: The May initiative targets low-carbon steel definitions, sustainable/circular design and information disclosure. The launched consultation closed 12 August; later drafting stages remain upcoming in the API.
impact_zh: 钢厂可提前整理碳足迹、再生材料及产品可追溯性资料；不要把倡议当成已经确定的进口标准或采购门槛，具体产品和指标尚需正式文件。
impact_en: Prepare footprint, recycled-input and traceability data; product scope and thresholds require the final instrument.

title_zh: 欧盟第三国碳价抵扣草案：按有效支付碳价并扣除补偿
title_en: EU third-country carbon-price draft: effective payments net of compensation
summary_zh: 5月13日发布的实施法规草案拟将第三国对申报内含排放实际支付的碳价换算为CBAM证书数量，并考虑降低碳价的补偿。官方API显示咨询于6月10日结束，当前记录未列采纳日期。本摘要不提供适用国家名单或最终抵扣公式。
summary_en: The 13 May draft would convert effective third-country carbon payments into certificates, accounting for compensation. Feedback closed 10 June; no adoption date is listed.
impact_zh: 中国钢厂应按装置留存碳成本付款、免费配额及返还资料，与进口商建立证据链；中国ETS市场报价不能自动视为全部可抵扣碳价。
impact_en: Retain installation-specific payment, free-allocation and refund evidence; a quoted ETS price is not automatically fully deductible.
coverage: 2026-10-09核对欧委会官方API dossierSummary及publications程序信息；未核读草案/采纳法案和附件全文，仅完成倡议摘要与状态核验，不作为当前完整法规研判。

title_zh: CBAM免费配额调整倡议：拟对齐2026—2030年EU ETS基准
title_en: CBAM free-allocation initiative aligns with 2026–2030 ETS benchmarks
summary_zh: 2月19日倡议拟把CBAM实施规则中的基准值与2026—2030年最终EU ETS基准对齐，使正式期调整一致反映免费配额规则。官方API当前已发布阶段为规划，草案反馈阶段待启动，未给新截止日期或采纳日期。
summary_en: The 19 February initiative would align CBAM benchmark values with final 2026–2030 EU ETS benchmarks. The published stage is planning; no new feedback deadline or adoption date is listed.
impact_zh: 出口商应让测算模型中的排放强度、基准和免费配额调整分别可更新。此倡议不提供可直接使用的最终系数，报价需核对现行正式规则。
impact_en: Keep emissions, benchmarks and allocation adjustments separately updateable; this initiative does not supply final quotation coefficients.

title_zh: CBAM申报格式倡议：标准表格、登记册提交及证书清缴规则待细化
title_en: CBAM declaration initiative: formats, registry submission and surrender
summary_zh: 2月19日倡议依据2023/956第6(6)条，拟规定CBAM申报标准格式、详细信息、经登记册提交程序及证书清缴安排。官方API已发布阶段为规划，后续草案阶段待启动，未列反馈截止或采纳日期。
summary_en: The initiative under Article 6(6) would define declaration formats, required information, registry submission and surrender arrangements. It remains in a planning stage in the API.
impact_zh: 钢厂与进口商应统一货物、装置、排放和核验数据字段及责任分工；不能把未发布的格式或期限写入强制交付要求。
impact_en: Align goods, installation, emissions and verification data responsibilities; do not invent unpublished mandatory formats or deadlines.

title_zh: CBAM专属经济区倡议记录：涉及第三国货物进入欧盟海域的适用条件
title_en: CBAM EEZ initiative record: third-country goods entering EU offshore areas
summary_zh: 官方API列示相关法案采纳日期为2025年10月31日、倡议版本发布于11月30日。摘要覆盖2023/956附件I货物及其加工品进入成员国专属经济区或大陆架时的进口等效概念、申报义务和海关控制；此处仅核验倡议记录，不给出正式法规号或完整执行条款。
summary_en: The API records adoption on 31 October 2025 and publication on 30 November. Its summary addresses Annex I goods and processed products entering an EU EEZ or continental shelf, declarations and customs controls.
impact_zh: 供应海上项目的钢材应核对项目位置、进口安排及正式法规，而不能因未进入陆地口岸就判断不适用CBAM。具体义务需逐项查最终文本。
impact_en: For offshore steel deliveries, verify location, import arrangements and the adopted instrument; absence of a land-port entry is not sufficient to establish exemption.
status: 已采纳记录 · 待核正式条文

title_zh: CBAM核验机构认可倡议：API列示2025年11月20日采纳
title_en: CBAM verifier accreditation initiative: adoption recorded 20 November 2025
summary_zh: 倡议摘要涵盖国家认可机构授予CBAM核验资格、认可后的监督、撤销以及认可机构相互承认和同行评审。官方API列示2025年11月20日采纳并发布；本条只核验倡议摘要和程序信息，未核读认可条件附件。
summary_en: The API records adoption/publication on 20 November 2025. The summary concerns accreditation, oversight, withdrawal, mutual recognition and peer evaluation; technical annexes are outside this review.
impact_zh: 钢厂采购核验服务时，应查有效认可范围和官方名录，不能把一般审计、咨询或预认证视为CBAM认可核验。合同中约定核验范围与责任。
impact_en: Check accreditation scope and official registers; general audits or pre-certification do not establish CBAM verifier accreditation.
status: 已采纳记录 · 待核正式条文

title_zh: 欧盟钢铁贸易措施2025年倡议归档：业务判断应转向2026年正式新规
title_en: EU 2025 steel-measure initiative archive: use the 2026 adopted regime
summary_zh: 2025年10月10日倡议版本记录欧委会于10月7日采纳相关提案，反馈阶段已结束。其摘要旨在应对全球过剩产能、旧保障措施于2026年6月30日到期的背景。该历史提案记录不等于2026年当前有效配额表。
summary_en: The October 2025 record concerns an adopted Commission proposal against overcapacity as the old safeguard approached expiry. It is historical proposal evidence, not the current quota schedule.
impact_zh: 输欧报价和报关应核对2026/1384及现行配额分配规则；避免引用历史提案中的建议值。咨询史可用于解释政策背景。
impact_en: Use Regulation 2026/1384 and current distribution acts for shipments; historical proposed values are unsuitable for current quotations.

title_zh: CBAM登记册修订倡议：2025年10月规划记录未列新的采纳日期
title_en: CBAM registry amendment initiative: planning record without adoption date
summary_zh: 2025年10月9日倡议拟修订建立CBAM登记册实施规则的若干要素。官方API已发布阶段仍为规划，后续草案反馈标为待启动，未列新的截止或采纳日期；摘要没有说明最终新增字段。
summary_en: The 9 October 2025 initiative would amend elements of registry rules. The API still exposes a planning publication with later drafting upcoming and no adoption date.
impact_zh: 进口商应监控登记册实际版本及主管机关通知，测试接口和数据字段变更；不要据笼统倡议臆测已实行的系统改动。
impact_en: Monitor actual registry releases and authority notices; do not infer implemented field changes from a general initiative summary.

title_zh: CBAM正式期方法学旧倡议：咨询已结束，计算应以现行正式规则为准
title_en: CBAM definitive methodology historical initiative: use current rules
summary_zh: 2025年8月28日倡议拟规定实际内含排放的计算方法以及间接排放方法要素。该阶段反馈于2025年9月25日结束；API后续阶段仍标为待启动。本记录仅是历史倡议，不能据此否定后来正式法规或2026年指引。
summary_en: The August 2025 initiative addresses actual embedded emissions and indirect-emissions methods. Feedback closed 25 September 2025; API stage labels do not establish the absence of later legislation.
impact_zh: 钢厂应按当前正式法规和2026指引建立装置排放监测，区分直接/间接排放及前体边界；不能从这段摘要推导某产品具体计费范围。
impact_en: Use current legislation/guidance for monitoring and boundaries; this summary cannot determine a product's chargeable emissions.

title_en: CBAM surrender/free-allocation historical initiative: no current relief factor
summary_zh: 2025年8月28日倡议拟规定授权申报人清缴证书如何反映EU ETS免费配额，并考虑ETS原则。该阶段意见期于2025年9月25日结束，API后续阶段标为待启动；此摘要未给当前产品基准或调整公式。
summary_en: The 2025 initiative concerns surrender adjustment reflecting ETS free allowances. Feedback closed 25 September 2025; the summary does not provide current product benchmarks or formulas.
impact_zh: 出口报价应独立核对排放、当期证书价格和现行免费配额调整，不可简单把历史倡议描述解释为固定折扣。

title_zh: CBAM下游扩围与反规避旧倡议：咨询结束不等于产品已纳入
title_en: CBAM downstream scope/anti-circumvention initiative: consultation is not coverage
summary_zh: 2025年7月1日倡议拟将部分下游产品纳入CBAM，降低生产外迁或进口替代导致的碳泄漏，并打击无正当经济理由的规避财务义务行为。公众咨询于8月26日结束；本API记录未列最终采纳日期或具体新增CN编码。

impact_zh: 下游制品出口商应逐项跟进最终CN范围、生效期及贸易链安排。不能仅凭媒体或倡议标题认定所有钢制品已经缴纳CBAM。
impact_en: Track final CN coverage, commencement and supply-chain rules; not all steel products become covered merely through this initiative.

title_en: CBAM authorised-declarant initiative: adoption recorded 17 March 2025

summary_en: The API records adoption on 17 March 2025 and publication on 28 March. The initiative concerns authorisation procedures and authority communications; later amendments are not assessed here.
impact_zh: 欧盟进口商应核对实际授权状态与现行资格规则，钢厂做好装置及排放资料支持。授权问题不能用一般注册或咨询公司承诺替代。
impact_en: Confirm actual authorisation against current rules; mills should provide installation/emissions evidence.

title_zh: CBAM登记册建立倡议：官方记录显示2024年12月18日采纳
title_en: CBAM registry establishment initiative: adoption recorded 18 December 2024
summary_zh: 官方API显示建立CBAM登记册的倡议已在2024年12月18日采纳，2025年1月3日发布该阶段版本，咨询关闭。摘要确认登记册设立，但未提供当前操作权限、字段或后续系统改版细节。
summary_en: The API records adoption on 18 December 2024 and publication on 3 January 2025. It confirms registry establishment but not current fields, access rights or later releases.
impact_zh: 进口商应以现行登记册指南核对账号权限和数据上传，生产装置与代理之间明确责任；历史建立记录不能替代最新操作说明。
impact_en: Check current registry access and upload instructions and allocate installation/agent responsibilities.
coverage: 2026-10-09核对欧委会官方API dossierSummary及publications程序信息；未核读草案/采纳法案和附件全文，仅完成倡议摘要与状态核验，不作为当前完整法规研判。

title_zh: 英国对华部分焊接管反倾销措施延至2031年，中国税率90.6%
title_en: UK extends welded-tube duties to 2031; China rate 90.6%
summary_zh: 英国贸易救济通知2026/24自2026年8月21日生效，相关措施自2026年1月30日起延长至2031年1月30日。适用外径不超过168.3毫米的圆截面铁或非合金钢焊接管；油气输送管、套管、精密管等除外。商品编码7306304120、7306307280、7306307780、7306304920；中国所有企业税率90.6%，附加编码8A91；白俄罗斯38.1%，8A90。按未完税边境净价计税。
summary_en: Notice 2026/24 takes effect on 21 August 2026 and extends the measure from 30 January 2026 to 30 January 2031. Covered circular welded iron/non-alloy tubes have an outside diameter up to 168.3 mm, with stated exclusions. Codes: 7306304120, 7306307280, 7306307780, 7306304920. China: 90.6%, additional code 8A91; Belarus: 38.1%, 8A90, on net frontier price before duty.
impact_zh: 输英前同时核对产品描述、用途、外径及税号；不能仅凭HS编码认定适用或豁免。报价应单列反倾销税并由进口商确认申报编码。
impact_en: Check scope, diameter, use and commodity codes before quoting; confirm declaration treatment with the importer.
coverage: 核读英国政府通知2026/24正文、产品描述、税率表及期限。

title_zh: CBAM指南1：区分嵌入排放、免费配额调整与已付碳价
title_en: CBAM Guidance 1: emissions, free-allocation adjustment and carbon price
summary_zh: 欧委会指南说明CBAM覆盖商品及生产装置的基本概念。证书义务须结合商品嵌入排放、对应免费配额调整和符合条件的第三国实际已付碳价，不能简单将钢材重量乘证书价格；指南是操作解释，不能替代法规。
summary_en: The guidance explains covered goods and installations. Certificate liability depends on embedded emissions, the free-allocation adjustment and eligible carbon price already paid abroad; tonnes of steel times certificate price is not the calculation.
impact_zh: 出口团队先建立CN编码、生产装置、前体材料和排放数据对应关系；与进口商分别核算排放、调整和碳价扣减。
impact_en: Map CN codes, installations, precursors and emissions; keep the three calculation components distinct.
coverage: 核读35页PDF中概念与证书计算关键章节；不声称逐项复算全部示例。

title_zh: CBAM指南2：境外钢厂须准备监测计划和可核查数据
title_en: CBAM Guidance 2: monitoring and verifiable data for non-EU mills
summary_zh: 境外生产者应识别覆盖商品、工艺边界和前体材料，制定监测计划并向欧盟进口商提供所需排放信息。生产者可通过O3CI登记或沟通模板分享数据；交易商同样需要协调实际生产装置。
summary_en: Non-EU operators should identify covered goods, process boundaries and precursors, prepare monitoring plans and provide emissions information. O3CI registration or communication templates support data sharing; traders must coordinate with producing installations.
impact_zh: 把数据责任落实到生产厂、前体供应商和进口商，提前安排核查；贸易商自己的说明不能替代生产装置数据。
impact_en: Assign data responsibilities across mills, precursor suppliers and importers; arrange verification early.
coverage: 核读15页PDF中境外生产者实施流程、数据沟通和内控要点；登记为自愿数据沟通渠道，不等于核查认可。

title_zh: CBAM指南4：免费配额调整须按商品、工艺和年份计算
title_en: CBAM Guidance 4: free-allocation adjustment is product and year specific
summary_zh: 指南将商品免费配额调整表示为单位商品调整量SEFA乘进口量M；生产工艺基准、CBAM因子、跨行业修正因子及前体材料共同影响结果。使用默认排放值时须配套默认调整量；实际数据须有相应核查依据。2026年进口按2026申报年度的调整规则处理，不因商品生产年份更早自动采用旧因子。
summary_en: FAA equals specific adjustment SEFA times imported quantity M. Benchmarks, the CBAM factor, cross-sectoral correction and precursors affect the result. Default emissions require matching default adjustment values. The reporting year governs the adjustment for 2026 imports, even for earlier production.
impact_zh: 不要给所有钢材套用统一折扣；维护CN编码、路线、前体和申报年度参数表，实际值与默认值场景分开报价。
impact_en: Avoid a universal discount; separate actual/default scenarios by CN code, route, precursor and reporting year.
coverage: 核读38页PDF第2—3章和前体材料关键段落；未对全部附件算例进行独立重算。

title_zh: CBAM钢铁指南5d：生产路线、前体与成材率影响单位排放
title_en: CBAM iron-and-steel Guidance 5d: routes, precursors and yield matter
summary_zh: 指南涵盖铁钢工艺边界和前体排放，单位为tCO₂e/t商品。钢铁通常计直接排放，但烧结矿CN26011200需计间接排放；不能把该例外扩大到所有矿石。钢坯、粗钢相关CN7206、7207、7218、7224及下游产品应按各自边界追溯；废钢不作为收费覆盖商品并不意味着工艺中的废钢碳完全不计。加工损耗和成材率会影响吨成品排放。
summary_en: The guidance addresses boundaries and precursor emissions in tCO2e/t goods. Steel generally uses direct emissions, while agglomerated ore CN26011200 includes indirect emissions. Crude/semi-finished steel codes include 7206, 7207, 7218 and 7224. Scrap scope exclusions do not erase process carbon; yield affects product intensity.
impact_zh: 整理各路线年报、前体核查证据和物料平衡；审查废钢分类、加工损耗及不同工艺是否同一装置，避免仅凭绿色钢宣传认定CBAM减免。
impact_en: Collect route-level annual reports, precursor evidence and mass balances; check scrap and yield treatment.
coverage: 核读65页PDF工艺边界、前体、钢铁特定参数与加工章节（第7—14、32—34页等）；未声称全部算例已重算。

title_zh: 华测旗下机构公告取得CBAM核查认可，证书范围仍需独立核对
title_en: CTI affiliate announces CBAM accreditation; certificate scope needs checking
summary_zh: 华测发布的企业公告称希腊EmiCert取得ESYD签发的CBAM认可，证书编号874-9，覆盖六个管制行业，并称为全球首家。已核读公告，但尚未在认可机构名录独立确认完整证书范围和“全球首家”说法；不能据公告为具体钢厂核查资格背书。
summary_en: CTI says Greek EmiCert obtained ESYD accreditation, certificate 874-9, covering six sectors. The announcement was read, but the register, detailed scope and “world first” claim were not independently verified.
impact_zh: 委托前索取有效证书、钢铁工艺认可范围、人员能力和签字权限，并与认可机构公开名录核对。
impact_en: Obtain the valid certificate and steel-process scope and check the accreditation register.
coverage: 核读华测发布的9月23日公告；六行业与首家为企业陈述，尚未独立核认证书附件。

title_zh: ECDPM评论：CBAM转向内部产业政策，第三国应加强数据能力
title_en: ECDPM commentary: CBAM and third-country data capacity
summary_zh: 作者认为CBAM正更多服务欧盟内部产业政策，并提醒发展中国家关注排放监测、资金和制度调整。属于智库评论，不能据此认定新的税率、豁免或已通过的下游扩围。
summary_en: The commentary argues that CBAM increasingly reflects internal EU industrial priorities and urges developing countries to address monitoring, finance and institutional capacity. It establishes no new rate or exemption.
impact_zh: 中国出口商可把装置数据、核查预算与进口商合作列入长期准备，但适用商品和法定期限仍查官方文件。
impact_en: Plan data and verification capacity; use official texts for legal scope and deadlines.
coverage: 核读PubAffairs转载的ECDPM署名评论；原评论10月6日，转载页10月8日，法律状态未以评论替代官方文件。

title_zh: CBAM下游扩围进入协商阶段，律所预计10月20日首次政治三方会谈
title_en: CBAM downstream proposal heads to trilogue; meeting dates need official confirmation
summary_zh: Mayer Brown梳理欧委会、理事会和议会的不同下游商品范围及反规避方案，称9月28日技术会议后，首次政治三方会谈计划10月20日，第二次暂定11月30日。日期为律所信息，本轮未取得官方议程确认；扩围仍是立法协商，不能将议会方案中的457类商品直接当成现行义务。
summary_en: Mayer Brown compares competing downstream and anti-circumvention proposals. It reports a 20 October political trilogue and tentative 30 November follow-up; official agenda confirmation remains outstanding. Parliament’s proposed 457 categories are not current final scope.
impact_zh: 下游出口企业先筛查产品和钢铝前体数据；10月20日前后核查官方协商结果，报价保留规则变化条款。
impact_en: Screen downstream products and precursor data; check official negotiations around 20 October.
coverage: 核读律所全文；欧议会原始文本遇机器人验证，未完成全部官方附件核验。

title_zh: 中国钢铁低碳转型推动澳大利亚重新评估矿石与绿铁出口
title_en: China steel transition prompts Australia to assess green-iron exports
summary_zh: 对话地球报道中国需求放缓和低碳工艺变化可能影响澳大利亚矿石出口，讨论绿铁路径、中澳研究合作，以及可再生电力、氢气、基础设施和矿石品位的约束。绿铁项目仍处探索期，受访者预测并不构成已确定采购需求。
summary_en: Dialogue Earth examines Australia’s ore and green-iron options as China’s steel sector changes. Power, hydrogen, infrastructure and ore quality remain constraints; interview projections do not establish committed purchases.
impact_zh: 中国钢厂评估矿石与绿铁时比较综合成本、品位和实际排放，优先验证试验数据及供应保障。
impact_en: Compare delivered cost, quality, measured emissions and supply reliability.
coverage: 核读对话地球中文报道主体；保留预测与项目试验性质，未核读其全部引用研究。

title_zh: 澳洲矿石的CBAM优势主要限于团聚矿，不能推广到粉矿和块矿
title_en: Australian CBAM ore advantage is limited to agglomerated ore
summary_zh: Fastmarkets分析称CBAM覆盖CN26011200的团聚矿，澳洲多数粉矿、块矿不在该类别；较低默认值可能影响使用球团、并以实际排放申报输欧钢材的亚洲钢厂采购。但可用产量、品位、运费和实际核查值同样重要，媒体比较值未在本轮逐项复核法规附件。
summary_en: Fastmarkets distinguishes CN26011200 agglomerated ore from Australian fines and lump. Potential precursor advantages depend on product availability, suitability, freight and the mill’s emissions reporting. Numerical defaults were not independently reconciled with the annex.
impact_zh: 按商品形态核对前体数据，先算冶炼和物流综合成本；不要把澳洲来源标签直接等同CBAM免税或固定节省。
impact_en: Check precursor form and total process/logistics cost; Australian origin is not an exemption.
coverage: 核读Fastmarkets正文及官方钢铁指南的前体范围；未独立复算预测贸易量和国家默认值表。

title_zh: 青山津巴布韦钢厂签铁路运输合作，煤和钢材运量为协议计划
title_en: Tsingshan’s Zimbabwe unit signs rail deal with planned coal and steel volumes
summary_zh: 路透报道Dinson与津巴布韦国家铁路合作，由集团企业提供机车、货车和燃料，国家铁路提供线路和人员。协议涉及110万吨煤、60万吨钢材运输，80公里既有线改造约2700万美元，随后建设50公里钢厂连接线。这些是协议计划，不是已完成运量或已建成铁路。
summary_en: Reuters reports a Dinson/NRZ deal for locomotives, wagons, fuel and railway services. Planned volumes are 1.1 Mt coal and 0.6 Mt steel, with an 80-km upgrade costing about USD27 million and a subsequent 50-km plant link; these are plans.
impact_zh: 关注融资、建设节点和运输履约，可降低当地钢厂物流瓶颈；不能立即据此增加区域可售产量。
impact_en: Track financing, construction and service delivery before assuming extra market supply.
coverage: 核读MarketScreener刊载的路透全文；Reuters入口访问失败，以带路透署名的转载正文核验，NRZ原始声明未独立取得。

title_zh: 台湾中钢11月月盘调涨NT$900/吨，应与中国大陆钢企区分
title_en: Taiwan CSC raises November monthly prices by NT$900/t
summary_zh: Yieh报道台湾China Steel Corporation对11月交货的主要月盘产品加价NT$900/吨，包含热轧、冷轧及部分镀锌板卷。此处“China Steel”指台湾中钢，不是中国大陆钢铁行业整体涨价；挂牌调价也不等于实际成交价。
summary_en: Yieh reports a NT$900/t increase for major November monthly products at Taiwan’s CSC, including hot/cold rolled and selected galvanized coils. “China Steel” is Taiwan CSC; list prices are not transaction prices.
impact_zh: 作为亚洲报价竞争参考，分别比较交期、币种、规格与成交折扣；避免主体名称误判。
impact_en: Compare Asian offers by delivery, currency, specification and discounts.
coverage: 核读Yieh10月6日报道核对涨幅与产品；未取得CSC原始月盘通知，不将媒体报价当作实时成交。

title_zh: Steelnews批评CBAM简化研究：中小企业仍面临数据成本
title_en: Steelnews questions SME relief in a CBAM simplification study
summary_zh: Gerber Group评论ERCST研究，认为拟议的小额采购简化对中小企业帮助有限，重点在2028年下游扩围背景下的大企业采购。属于行业观点和研究建议，未确认为已生效的额外豁免。
summary_en: Gerber Group critiques an ERCST study’s proposed small-purchase relief, arguing it offers limited SME benefit. The proposal is not an enacted additional exemption.
impact_zh: 中国供应商仍应准备客户要求的排放资料，不据行业评论停止申报；低吨位多供应商业务评估数据成本。
impact_en: Continue preparing customer data; assess costs for low-volume, multi-supplier trade.
coverage: 核读Steelnews评论全文；ERCST研究模型与豁免方案未逐项独立复核。

title_zh: 乌克兰雇主组织要求推迟CBAM付款，属于政策诉求
title_en: Ukrainian employers seek CBAM payment deferral
summary_zh: 乌克兰雇主联合会负责人在署名文章中主张继续实际排放报告、因战争推迟收费，并要求政府加强与欧盟交涉。其配额、默认值和经济损失说法为当事方陈述，文章不能证明欧盟已经批准延期或乌克兰钢材豁免。
summary_en: A Ukrainian employers’ representative calls for reporting but deferred payment due to war. Quota and default-value criticisms are the author’s claims, not evidence of an EU-approved exemption.
impact_zh: 关注可能改变竞争条件的谈判；现有合同不应预设乌克兰获豁免，更不能推导中国出口同等待遇。
impact_en: Monitor negotiations without assuming Ukrainian exemption or equivalent treatment for China.
coverage: 完整核读GMK署名观点；相关法律豁免、配额个案与损失估算未独立确认。

title_zh: ACEA研究倡议减少CBAM报告负担，并非新增法定豁免
title_en: ACEA advocates reducing CBAM reporting burden
summary_zh: ACEA介绍委托ERCST开展的研究，指出整卷钢和极少量紧固件在逐项数据报告上都可能产生较高固定成本，提出优化小额进口处理。页面陈述的是行业研究与建议，不是欧盟已采纳的新豁免门槛。
summary_en: ACEA discusses commissioned ERCST research into fixed reporting costs for large coils versus tiny fastener purchases and advocates improved small-volume treatment. It establishes no newly enacted threshold.
impact_zh: 供应商按客户、CN编码和生产装置组织数据，减少重复核查；仍按正式法规确认豁免资格。
impact_en: Organize reusable data by customer, code and installation; use legislation for exemptions.
coverage: 核读ACEA页面正文；未核读ERCST研究附件全部模型。

title_zh: 韩国媒体：低价中国热轧镀锌板加剧竞争，业界要求扩大救济
title_en: Korean report: Chinese hot-rolled galvanized offers intensify competition
summary_zh: 《每日经济》报道中国HGI报价约620美元/吨（约84万韩元），韩国CGI报价超过100万韩元，业界称价差超过15%，并担忧年约100万吨镀锌板市场。HGI与CGI生产路线不同；报道中的扩大反倾销、配额和保障措施均为业界诉求，尚未取得官方决定核验。
summary_en: Maeil Business reports Chinese HGI offers around USD620/t (KRW840,000), versus Korean CGI above KRW1 million, and industry calls for wider remedies. HGI/CGI differ in processing; demands for quotas or safeguards are not verified official measures.
impact_zh: 韩国订单核对冷轧工序、镀层与产品描述；勿仅凭媒体报道断言HGI免税或规避合规，应跟进韩国官方调查范围。
impact_en: Check process, coating and scope; do not assume exemption or lawful avoidance from the report.
status: 媒体报道·官方范围待核
coverage: 核读Daum刊载的韩文《每日经济》正文；报价为当日报道，韩国正式税令和扩围决定未取得。

title_zh: Climate Analytics发布西巴尔干三国CBAM应对政策简报
title_en: Climate Analytics outlines CBAM options for three Balkan economies
summary_zh: 机构发布阿尔巴尼亚、波黑和塞尔维亚政策简报，研究覆盖行业的CBAM暴露与通过成本有效减排降低风险的路径。网页确认研究范围及报告入口，不足以核实每国详细税额或所有模型假设。
summary_en: The institute’s publication page introduces Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and Serbia briefs on CBAM exposure and cost-effective decarbonisation. The landing page does not verify country cost models.
impact_zh: 作为欧洲邻近市场竞争和合作线索；涉及当地客户的项目再核读国别简报，不据摘要判断具体成本。
impact_en: Use as a regional screening lead; read country briefs before costing specific projects.
coverage: 核读机构发布页正文与三份报告入口；未核读三份国别PDF和五份行业深度报告。

title_zh: 9月30日矿石期货报道接近710元/吨，属于历史行情
title_en: 30 September ore futures report near CNY710/t is historical
summary_zh: IndexBox引用Trading Economics称铁矿石期货反弹至接近710元/吨，将其与制造业数据和国庆前交易安排联系。是9月30日市场评论；未给出可独立核对的完整合约与成交时点，不能显示成今日价格。
summary_en: IndexBox cites Trading Economics for ore futures near CNY710/t in a 30 September market commentary. The precise contract/time was not independently checked; it is not today’s quote.
impact_zh: 采购和套保使用交易所的对应合约、时点与交割标准；市场评论只作背景。
impact_en: Use exchange-specific contracts and timestamps for procurement and hedging.
coverage: 核读IndexBox新闻正文；行情与宏观数据未独立对账，不作为实时报价。

title_zh: Rhodium研究：中国绿钢路线受废钢、氢气和高炉投资周期影响
title_en: Rhodium examines scrap, hydrogen and furnace investment in Chinese green steel
summary_zh: 研究认为需求下降与废钢增加可能推动减排，同时高炉续建会锁定化石路线；焦炉煤气和高炉富氢改造是渐进路线，绿氢DRI仍需规模化。其CBAM影响和长期排放预测均有模型假设，不能作为具体装置应缴税额。
summary_en: Rhodium discusses demand decline, scrap growth, furnace reinvestment and hydrogen pathways. Its long-term emissions and CBAM estimates are model-dependent and do not establish plant-specific liability.
impact_zh: 评估高炉改造与新路线时同时考虑资源、实际排放和投资寿命；出口税费另用已核查的装置数据计算。
impact_en: Assess resources, measured emissions and asset life; calculate export liability separately.
coverage: 核读Rhodium网页研究主体；未独立重算模型、下载附件及税费假设。

title_zh: 美国艾奥瓦州宣布拟建综合钢厂，尚处投资计划阶段
title_en: Iowa announces proposed integrated steel complex
summary_zh: 艾奥瓦州政府9月28日公告称Mesabi Metallics计划在该州建设综合钢铁基地，并将其描述为重大投资。公告未提供已投产证明、详细建设时间表或可用于出口预测的确定供货量；新闻中的投资与就业承诺不等于建成产能。
summary_en: Iowa’s 28 September release says Mesabi Metallics plans an integrated steel complex. It does not establish operational capacity, a detailed delivery schedule or firm export volumes.
impact_zh: 对中国钢企是美国本土化竞争信号；跟踪许可、融资和建设进展，避免把计划产能加入近期供给。
impact_en: Track permitting, financing and construction before counting near-term supply.
coverage: 核读州政府9月28日公告全文；未以媒体投资额和就业预测补充未证实的投产结论。

title_zh: 首钢京唐与力拓投运高炉煤气碳捕集试验装置
title_en: Shougang and Rio Tinto commission blast-furnace gas capture trial
summary_zh: 力拓9月28日公告称试验装置处理高炉煤气3000立方米/小时，设计年捕集1万吨CO₂，在2022年合作备忘录和2024年较小试验基础上推进。余热利用与捕集碳制合成气仍是技术探索，设计能力不是已实现全年减排或已签发碳信用。
summary_en: Rio Tinto reports a trial processing 3,000 m3/hour of blast-furnace gas, designed to capture 10,000 tCO2/year. Heat integration and captured-carbon use remain research; design capacity is not measured annual abatement or issued credits.
impact_zh: 关注连续运行、能耗和捕集碳去向；CBAM申报以适用方法和可核查实绩为准，不能仅凭装置投运扣减。
impact_en: Track operating data and carbon destination; a commissioning announcement alone does not justify CBAM deductions.
coverage: 核读力拓9月28日原始公告；未审计运行结果或认证碳信用。

title_zh: 拉米主张乌克兰钢材免于CBAM，尚不能认定获准豁免
title_en: Lamy advocates Ukrainian steel exemption; approval not established
summary_zh: GMK转述前欧盟贸易委员拉米观点：战争背景下应豁免乌克兰钢材，并称相关提案仍在立法过程中。报道使用应当豁免的意见表述，不能证明欧盟已决定免除证书义务。
summary_en: GMK reports former EU trade commissioner Lamy’s view that Ukrainian steel should be exempt during war and says proposals remain in legislation. This is advocacy, not proof of an adopted exemption.
impact_zh: 跟踪正式法律文本及适用期限，不据访谈调整中国或乌克兰来源钢材的税费预算。
impact_en: Check adopted texts before changing cost budgets for either origin.
coverage: 核读GMK报道全文；Forbes原始访谈及欧盟豁免法律未独立核验。

title_zh: 媒体转述EUROFER碳成本预测：2031年82亿欧元并非法定税额
title_en: Reported EUROFER EUR8.2bn carbon-cost scenario is not a legal bill
summary_zh: IndexBox转述EUROFER估算，欧洲钢铁年碳成本或由2026年34亿欧元升至2031年82亿欧元，并呼吁渐进取消免费配额。是协会情景预测及政策诉求；本轮未取得完整原模型，不能推导中国钢材每吨确定CBAM税额。
summary_en: IndexBox attributes a EUR3.4bn-to-EUR8.2bn annual-cost scenario to EUROFER and reports its call for gradual free-allocation phase-out. The underlying model was not verified; it gives no fixed Chinese CBAM rate.
impact_zh: 关注欧洲钢厂竞争与政策压力，预算按碳价、工艺和免费配额分别做情景，不把协会总额平均分摊到出口商品。
impact_en: Model prices, routes and adjustments separately; do not allocate an association total to export tonnes.
coverage: 核读IndexBox正文；未取得EUROFER原报告和模型，82亿欧元仅作为已核读的归属明确的媒体陈述。

title_zh: Steelnews称下游扩围将增加报告负担，成本数字为自行推算
title_en: Steelnews warns of downstream reporting burden using its own estimates
summary_zh: Gerber Group批评拟议CBAM下游扩围，认为按吨位衡量负担低估多产品、多供应商企业的固定合规成本。其企业数量和行政成本是自行外推，不是正式征税决定，也未在本轮独立复算。
summary_en: Gerber Group argues that proposed downstream expansion underestimates fixed compliance costs for multi-product suppliers. Its company-count and cost extrapolations are not tax decisions and were not independently recalculated.
impact_zh: 建立可复用的材料来源、CN编码和装置数据，评估系统成本；最终扩围范围仍等正式法规。
impact_en: Prepare reusable origin/code/installation data and await enacted scope.
coverage: 核读评论正文；未确认其全部统计、立法附件或行政成本推算。

title_zh: IndexBox报道7月钢铁流量增长1%，统计口径仍待核对
title_en: IndexBox reports July steel flows up 1%; scope needs confirmation
summary_zh: 媒体称7月钢铁流量2220万吨、同比增1%，中国增长而其他来源下降近8%。该网页未提供可复算的完整底层数据与统计口径；其熔炼浇铸法律判断未以本轮可读正式法条确认，不能把“流量”直接当全球海关钢材出口总量。
summary_en: IndexBox reports July flows of 22.2 Mt, up 1%, with China growing and other origins down nearly 8%. The underlying scope/data were not reconciled; flows should not be treated as total world customs exports.
impact_zh: 用于市场方向筛查；订单决策再核对海关品类、目的地及正式原产地规则，尤其避免把加工转口概括为全面禁止。
impact_en: Reconcile customs categories and official origin rules before routing orders.
coverage: 核读IndexBox新闻正文；底层数据、贸易口径及其法规推论未独立验证。

title_zh: 媒体称中钢协预计十五五需求保持8亿吨以上，属于行业预测
title_en: Reported CISA 800-Mt demand outlook is an industry forecast
summary_zh: IndexBox引述SteelOrbis称中钢协会长刘键预计2026—2030年年需求仍在8亿吨以上但总体下行。河钢9月21日原始大会报道确认讲话和产能治理、提质、能碳效率等方向，未列出该数值；数字尚未获得讲话原稿独立印证，更不是政府生产配额。
summary_en: IndexBox attributes an above-800-Mt annual demand outlook for 2026–2030 to CISA’s Liu Jian. HBIS confirms his speech and strategic themes but omits that figure; it is an uncorroborated reported forecast, not a production quota.
impact_zh: 分产品做需求情景，结合高端化和产能治理；不要按“8亿吨”当作确定产量或政府目标。
impact_en: Use product-level scenarios rather than treating 800 Mt as a binding target.
coverage: 核读IndexBox正文，并核对河钢原始大会报道https://hbisco.com/news/hbis/group/t709/3433；8亿吨数值未获原始讲话印证。

title_zh: 必和必拓与宝武续签五年低碳炼钢合作，减排比例为目标
title_en: BHP and Baowu renew five-year decarbonisation partnership
summary_zh: BHP9月21日公告续签五年合作，推进高炉改造、DRI及电熔炼等路径。改造高炉至少降低30%排放强度、结合CCS与可再生能源可超过80%的表述为研发目标和条件情景，不是全部宝武产品已实现的减排结果。
summary_en: BHP renews a five-year partnership covering blast-furnace retrofits, DRI and electric smelting. At least 30% lower intensity and potentially over 80% with CCS/renewables are targets and conditional scenarios, not achieved performance for all Baowu products.
impact_zh: 跟踪中试、能耗与装置级核查，区分研发结果和商业商品证据；出口客户承诺不能引用目标代替实绩。
impact_en: Track trials and verified installation performance; do not sell targets as achieved product reductions.
coverage: 核读BHP9月21日原始公告；未审计全部试验结果，条件减排目标明确与实绩区分。

title_zh: 7月S&P报道中国半成品出口创新高，三季度放缓是当时预测
title_en: July S&P report records semi-finished export surge and a conditional Q3 outlook
summary_zh: S&P7月20日报道6月半成品出口283.9万吨，半成品与成品合计1315.9万吨；上半年两者合计6446.8万吨，同比增0.7%。受访者担忧订单减弱导致三季度回落，属于当时判断。报道钢坯段落的月份表述存在不一致，未采用该分项数字。
summary_en: S&P reported 2.839 Mt semi-finished June exports and 13.159 Mt combined exports; H1 combined exports were 64.468 Mt, up 0.7%. The Q3 slowdown was a July forecast. An inconsistent billet-month reference was omitted.
impact_zh: 统计比较必须区分成品与包含半成品的口径；本轮是补录历史分析，不将7月预测写成10月已验证结果。
impact_en: Separate finished-only from combined totals; historical forecasts are not current confirmed outcomes.
coverage: 完整核读S&P正文；原始海关明细未逐项对账，保留历史时点与预测性质。

title_zh: 敬业就英国钢铁国有化要求补偿，金额与争端结果尚未确定
